   1 <?php
   2 if (extension_loaded('xdebug') && function_exists('xdebug_get_code_coverage')) {
   3     $data = xdebug_get_code_coverage();
   4     xdebug_stop_code_coverage(false); // false = keep accumulated data
   5 
   6     $dir = '/var/www/coverage';
   7     if (!is_dir($dir)) {
   8         mkdir($dir, 0777, true);
   9     }
  10 
  11     // PHP 5.6-compatible random suffix
  12     if (function_exists('openssl_random_pseudo_bytes')) {
  13         $rand = bin2hex(openssl_random_pseudo_bytes(4));
  14     } else {
  15         // fallback if OpenSSL not available
  16         $rand = bin2hex(substr(md5(uniqid(mt_rand(), true)), 0, 4));
  17     }
  18 
  19     // One file per request, named by time + random suffix to avoid collisions
  20     $file = $dir . '/cov_' . microtime(true) . '_' . $rand . '.ser';
  21     file_put_contents($file, serialize($data));
  22 }

/coverage-scripts/generate_report.php

   1 <?php
   2 /**
   3  * Run this manually inside the container to produce an HTML report.
   4  * Usage: php /coverage-scripts/generate_report.php /var/www/html /var/www/coverage
   5  */
   6 
   7 // PHP 5.6-compatible argument handling
   8 $appRoot  = isset($argv[1]) ? $argv[1] : '/var/www/html';
   9 $coverDir = isset($argv[2]) ? $argv[2] : '/var/www/coverage';
  10 $outFile  = $coverDir . '/report.html';
  11 
  12 // Merge all serialized coverage files
  13 $merged = array();
  14 foreach (glob($coverDir . '/cov_*.ser') as $f) {
  15     $data = unserialize(file_get_contents($f));
  16     foreach ($data as $file => $lines) {
  17         foreach ($lines as $line => $status) {
  18             if (!isset($merged[$file][$line])) {
  19                 $merged[$file][$line] = $status;
  20             } elseif ($status === 1) {
  21                 $merged[$file][$line] = 1; // executed beats not-executed
  22             }
  23         }
  24     }
  25 }
  26 
  27 // Build report
  28 $totalLines = 0;
  29 $coveredLines = 0;
  30 $rows = '';
  31 
  32 ksort($merged);
  33 foreach ($merged as $phpFile => $lines) {
  34     if (!is_file($phpFile)) continue;
  35     $source   = file($phpFile);
  36     $relPath  = str_replace($appRoot, '', $phpFile);
  37     $fileTot  = 0;
  38     $fileCov  = 0;
  39 
  40     foreach ($lines as $line => $status) {
  41         $fileTot++;
  42         if ($status === 1) $fileCov++;
  43     }
  44 
  45     $totalLines   += $fileTot;
  46     $coveredLines += $fileCov;
  47     $pct = $fileTot > 0 ? round($fileCov / $fileTot * 100, 1) : 0;
  48 
  49     if ($pct >= 80) {
  50         $color = '#2d7a2d';
  51     } elseif ($pct >= 40) {
  52         $color = '#b07d00';
  53     } else {
  54         $color = '#a02020';
  55     }
  56 
  57     $rows .= "<tr>
  58         <td><a href='#" . md5($phpFile) . "'>{$relPath}</a></td>
  59         <td>{$fileCov}/{$fileTot}</td>
  60         <td style='color:{$color};font-weight:500'>{$pct}%</td>
  61     </tr>";
  62 }
  63 
  64 $totalPct = $totalLines > 0 ? round($coveredLines / $totalLines * 100, 1) : 0;
  65 
  66 // File-level detail
  67 $detail = '';
  68 foreach ($merged as $phpFile => $lines) {
  69     if (!is_file($phpFile)) continue;
  70     $source  = file($phpFile);
  71     $relPath = str_replace($appRoot, '', $phpFile);
  72 
  73     $detail .= "<h3 id='" . md5($phpFile) . "'>" . htmlspecialchars($relPath) . "</h3><pre>";
  74 
  75     foreach ($source as $i => $srcLine) {
  76         $lineNo = $i + 1;
  77 
  78         // PHP 5.6-compatible null coalescing replacement
  79         $status = isset($lines[$lineNo]) ? $lines[$lineNo] : null;
  80 
  81         if ($status === 1) {
  82             $class = 'cov';
  83         } elseif ($status === -1) {
  84             $class = 'uncov';
  85         } elseif ($status === -2) {
  86             $class = 'dead';
  87         } else {
  88             $class = 'noexec';
  89         }
  90 
  91         $detail .= "<span class='{$class}'>" . sprintf('%4d', $lineNo) . ' '
  92                  . htmlspecialchars($srcLine) . "</span>";
  93     }
  94 
  95     $detail .= "</pre>";
  96 }
  97 
  98 $html = <<<HTML
  99 <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
 100 <title>Coverage Report</title>
 101 <style>
 102 body{font-family:sans-serif;margin:2rem;background:#fafafa;color:#222}
 103 table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin-bottom:2rem}
 104 th,td{text-align:left;padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}
 105 th{background:#eee}
 106 pre{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;overflow-x:auto;background:#1e1e1e;
 107     color:#d4d4d4;padding:1rem;border-radius:4px}
 108 .cov  {background:#1a3a1a;color:#98e898;display:block}
 109 .uncov{background:#3a1a1a;color:#e89898;display:block}
 110 .dead {background:#2a2a1a;color:#e8e898;display:block}
 111 .noexec{display:block}
 112 h2{margin-top:0}
 113 </style></head><body>
 114 <h2>Coverage report</h2>
 115 <p>Total: <strong>{$coveredLines}/{$totalLines} lines ({$totalPct}%)</strong></p>
 116 <table><tr><th>File</th><th>Lines</th><th>Coverage</th></tr>
 117 {$rows}
 118 </table>
 119 {$detail}
 120 </body></html>
 121 HTML;
 122 
 123 file_put_contents($outFile, $html);
 124 
 125 echo "Report written to {$outFile}\n";
 126 echo "Total coverage: {$totalPct}% ({$coveredLines}/{$totalLines} lines)\n";

   3 /**
   4  * Class to provide a calendar with additional data (tasks, milestones)
   5  *
   6  * @author Philipp Kiszka <info@o-dyn.de>
   7  * @name calendar
   8  * @package Collabtive
   9  * @version 2.0
  10  * @link http://collabtive.o-dyn.de
  11  * @license http://opensource.org/licenses/gpl-license.php GNU General Public License v3 or later
  12  */
  13 class calendar {
  14     private $daysInMonth;
  15     private $daysLastMonth;
  16     private $weeksInMonth;
  17     private $firstDay;
  18     private $month;
  19     private $year;
  20     private $project;
  21     public $calendar;
  22 
  23     /**
  24      * Constructor
  25      *
  26      * @access protected
  27      */
  28     function __construct()
  29     {
  30         $this->calendar = array();
  31     }
  32 
  33     /**
  34      * Get the calendar array for a given month and year (and project)
  35      *
  36      * @param int $month Month without leading zero (e.g. 5 for March)
  37      * @param int $year Year in the format yyyy (e.g. 2008)
  38      * @param int $project Project ID (default: 0 => no project selected, so get the calendar for all projects)
  39      * @return array
  40      */
  41     public function getCal($month, $year, $project = 0)
  42     {
  43         $this->month = $month;
  44         $this->year = $year;
  45         // get number of days in the given and the previous month
  46         $this->daysInMonth = date("t", mktime(0, 0, 0, $month, 1, $year));
  47         $this->daysLastMonth = date("t", mktime(0, 0, 0, $month-1, 1, $year));
  48         // get first day of the month
  49         $this->firstDay = date("w", mktime(0, 0, 0, $month, 1, $year))-1;
  50         $tempDays = $this->firstDay + $this->daysInMonth;
  51         $this->weeksInMonth = ceil($tempDays / 7);
  52 
  53         $this->project = $project;
  54 
  55         return $this->buildCal();
  56     }
  57 
  58     /**
  59      * Populates the array of calendar information
  60      *
  61      * @return array
  62      */
  63     private function buildCal()
  64     {
  65         $counter = 0;
  66         $milestoneObj = new milestone();
  67         $taskObj = new task();
  68 
  69         for($j = 0; $j < $this->weeksInMonth; $j++) {
  70             for($i = 0; $i < 7; $i++) {
  71                 $counter++;
  72                 $theday = $counter - $this->firstDay;
  73 
  74                 if ($theday < 1) {
  75                     $this->calendar[$j][$i]["val"] = $this->daysLastMonth + $theday;
  76                     $this->calendar[$j][$i]["currmonth"] = 0;
  77                 } elseif ($theday > $this->daysInMonth) {
  78                     $this->calendar[$j][$i]["val"] = $theday - $this->daysInMonth;
  79                     $this->calendar[$j][$i]["currmonth"] = 0;
  80                 } else {
  81                     $miles = $milestoneObj->getTodayMilestones($this->month, $this->year, $theday, $this->project);
  82                     $milesnum = count($miles);
  83 
  84                     $tasks = $taskObj->getTodayTasks($this->month, $this->year, $theday, $this->project);
  85                     $tasksnum = count($tasks);
  86 
  87                     $this->calendar[$j][$i] = array("val" => $theday,
  88                         "milestones" => $miles,
  89                         "milesnum" => $milesnum,
  90                         "tasks" => $tasks,
  91                         "tasksnum" => $tasksnum,
  92                         "currmonth" => 1
  93                         );
  94                 }
  95             }
  96         }
  97         return $this;
  98     }
  99 }

   3 abstract class databaseModel
   4 {
   5     protected $databaseTable;
   6 
   7 
   8     protected function addElement(array $fields)
   9     {
  10         global $conn;
  11         $sqlQuery = "INSERT INTO " . $this->databaseTable . " (";
  12         $fieldcount = count($fields);
  13 
  14         foreach ($fields as $name => $value) {
  15             $sqlQuery .= $name . ",";
  16         }
  17         //remove superflous comma
  18         $sqlQuery = substr($sqlQuery, 0, strlen($sqlQuery) - 1);
  19         $sqlQuery .= ") VALUES (";
  20 
  21         for ($i = 0; $i < $fieldcount; $i++) {
  22             $sqlQuery .= "?,";
  23         }
  24 
  25         //remove comma
  26         $sqlQuery = substr($sqlQuery, 0, strlen($sqlQuery) - 1);
  27         $sqlQuery .= ")";
  28         //execute the query
  29         $stmt = $conn->prepare($sqlQuery);
  30         $stmt->execute(array_values($fields));
  31 
  32         //return the ID for the element
  33         return $conn->lastInsertId();
  34     }
  35 
  36     protected function editElement($id, $fields)
  37     {
  38         global $conn;
  39 
  40         $sqlQuery = "UPDATE " . $this->databaseTable . " SET ";
  41 
  42         foreach ($fields as $name => $value) {
  43             $sqlQuery .= $name . "=?,";
  44         }
  45         //remove comma
  46         $sqlQuery = substr($sqlQuery, 0, strlen($sqlQuery) - 1);
  47         $sqlQuery .= " WHERE ID = ?";
  48 
  49         $stmt = $conn->prepare($sqlQuery);
  50 
  51         $values = array_values($fields);
  52         array_push($values, $id);
  53         return $stmt->execute($values);
  54     }
  55 
  56     protected function getElement($id)
  57     {
  58         global $conn;
  59 
  60         $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM " . $this->databaseTable . " WHERE ID = ?");
  61         $stmt->execute(array($id));
  62 
  63         return $stmt->fetch();
  64     }
  65 
  66     protected function getLimited($limit, $offset)
  67     {
  68         global $conn;
  69         $limit = (int)$limit;
  70         $offset = (int)$offset;
  71 
  72         $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM " . $this->databaseTable . " LIMIT $limit OFFSET $offset");
  73         $stmt->execute();
  74 
  75         return $stmt->fetchAll();
  76     }
  77 
  78     protected function getAllElements()
  79     {
  80         global $conn;
  81 
  82         $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM " . $this->databaseTable);
  83         $stmt->execute();
  84 
  85         return $stmt->fetchAll();
  86     }
  87 
  88     protected function getElementsBy(array $parameters)
  89     {
  90         global $conn;
  91         $sqlQuery = "SELECT * FROM " . $this->databaseTable . " WHERE ";
  92 
  93         $i = 0;
  94         foreach ($parameters as $name => $value) {
  95             if ($i > 0) {
  96                 $sqlQuery .= " AND ";
  97             }
  98             $sqlQuery .= $name . " = ?";
  99 
 100             $i++;
 101         }
 102         $stmt = $conn->prepare($sqlQuery);
 103         $stmt->execute(array_values($parameters));
 104 
 105         return $stmt->fetchAll();
 106     }
 107 
 108     protected function countElements()
 109     {
 110         global $conn;
 111 
 112         $countStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " . $this->databaseTable);
 113         $countStmt->execute();
 114 
 115         $count = $countStmt->fetch();
 116         $count = $count["COUNT(*)"];
 117 
 118         return $count;
 119     }
 120 
 121     protected function deleteElement($id)
 122     {
 123         global $conn;
 124         $id = (int)$id;
 125 
 126         $delStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM deployments WHERE ID = ? LIMIT 1");
 127 
 128         return $delStmt->execute(array($id));
 129     }

   3 /**
   4  * The class provides methods for the realization of messages and replies.
   5  *
   6  * @author Philipp Kiszka <info@o-dyn.de>
   7  * @name message
   8  * @version 2.0
   9  * @package Collabtive
  10  * @link http://collabtive.o-dyn.de
  11  * @license http://opensource.org/licenses/gpl-license.php GNU General Public License v3 or later
  12  */
  13 class message
  14 {
  15     /**
  16      * Creates a new message or a reply to a message
  17      *
  18      * @param int $project Project ID the message belongs to
  19      * @param string $title Title/Subject of the message
  20      * @param string $text Textbody of the message
  21      * @param string $tags Tags for the message
  22      * @param int $user User ID of the user adding the message
  23      * @param string $username Name of the user adding the message
  24      * @param int $replyto ID of the message this message is replying to. Standardmessage: 0
  25      * @param int $milestone ID of the milestone to attach this message to
  26      * @return bool
  27      */
  28     function add($project, $title, $text, $user, $username, $replyto, $milestone)
  29     {
  30         global $conn, $mylog;
  31 
  32         $insStmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO messages (`project`,`title`,`text`,`tags`,`posted`,`user`,`username`,`replyto`,`milestone`) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )");
  33         $ins = $insStmt->execute(array((int)$project, $title, $text, "", time(), (int)$user, $username, (int)$replyto, (int)$milestone));
  34 
  35         $insid = $conn->lastInsertId();
  36         if ($ins) {
  37             $mylog->add($title, 'message', 1, $project);
  38             return $insid;
  39         } else {
  40             return false;
  41         }
  42     }
  43 
  44     /**
  45      * Edits a message
  46      *
  47      * @param int $id Eindeutige Nummer der Nachricht
  48      * @param string $title Titel der Nachricht
  49      * @param string $text Text der Nachricht
  50      * @param string $tags Tags for the message
  51      * @return bool
  52      */
  53     function edit($id, $title, $text)
  54     {
  55         global $conn, $mylog;
  56 
  57         $updStmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE `messages` SET `title`=?, `text`=? WHERE ID = ?");
  58         $upd = $updStmt->execute(array($title, $text, (int)$id));
  59 
  60         if ($upd) {
  61             $projStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT project FROM messages WHERE ID = ?");
  62             $projStmt->execute(array($id));
  63 
  64             $project = $projStmt->fetch();
  65             $projectId = $project[0];
  66             $mylog->add($title, 'message', 2, $projectId);
  67             return true;
  68         } else {
  69             return false;
  70         }
  71     }
  72 
  73     /**
  74      * Deletes a message and all dependent messages
  75      *
  76      * @param int $id Eindeutige Nummer der Nachricht
  77      * @return bool
  78      */
  79     function del($id)
  80     {
  81         global $conn, $mylog;
  82         $id = (int)$id;
  83 
  84         $msgStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT title,project FROM messages WHERE ID = ?");
  85         $msgStmt->execute(array($id));
  86         $msg = $msgStmt->fetch();
  87 
  88         //delete the message
  89         $delStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM messages WHERE ID = ?");
  90         $del = $delStmt->execute(array($id));
  91 
  92         //delete replies to this message
  93         $deleteRepliesStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM messages WHERE replyto = ?");
  94         $deleteRepliesStmt->execute(array($id));
  95 
  96         //delete user<->message connections
  97         $deleteUsersAssingedStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM messages_assigned WHERE message = ?");
  98         $deleteUsersAssingedStmt->execute(array($id));
  99 
 100         //delete file attachments
 101         $deleteFileAttachmentsStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM files_attached WHERE message = ?");
 102         $deleteFileAttachmentsStmt->execute(array($id));
 103 
 104 
 105         if ($del) {
 106             $mylog->add($msg[0], 'message', 3, $msg[1]);
 107             return true;
 108         } else {
 109             return false;
 110         }
 111     }
 112 
 113     /**
 114      * Return a message including its answers
 115      *
 116      * @param int $id Eindeutige Nummer der Nachricht
 117      * @return array $message Eigenschaften der Nachricht
 118      */
 119     function getMessage($id, $recurseReplies = true)
 120     {
 121         global $conn;
 122         $id = (int)$id;
 123 
 124         $messageStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM messages WHERE ID = ? LIMIT 1");
 125         $messageStmt->execute(array($id));
 126         $message = $messageStmt->fetch();
 127 
 128         $milesobj = new milestone();
 129         if (!empty($message)) {
 130             $user = new user();
 131             $avatar = $user->getAvatar($message["user"]);
 132 
 133             $message["gender"] = "m";
 134 
 135             $project = $conn->query("SELECT name FROM projekte WHERE ID = $message[project]")->fetch();
 136             $message["pname"] = $project[0];
 137             $posted = date(CL_DATEFORMAT . " - H:i", $message["posted"]);
 138             $message["postdate"] = $posted;
 139             $message["endstring"] = $posted;
 140             $message["avatar"] = $avatar;
 141 
 142             if ($recurseReplies) {
 143                 //get children
 144                 $replies = $this->getReplies($id);
 145                 if (!$replies) {
 146                     $message["replies"] = 0;
 147                 } else {
 148                     $message["replies"] = count($replies);
 149                 }
 150                 $message["listReplies"] = $replies;
 151             }
 152             //get files attached to this message
 153             $attachedFiles = $this->getAttachedFiles($message["ID"]);
 154             //if there is files set hasFiles to true, else false
 155             if (!empty($attachedFiles)) {
 156                 $message["hasFiles"] = true;
 157                 $message["files"] = $attachedFiles;
 158 
 159             }
 160             else
 161             {
 162                 $message["hasFiles"] = false;
 163                 $message["files"] = [];
 164             }
 165 
 166             if ($message["milestone"] > 0) {
 167                 $milestones = $milesobj->getMilestone($message["milestone"]);
 168                 $message["hasMilestones"] = true;
 169                 $message["milestones"] = $milestones;
 170             }
 171             else
 172             {
 173                 $message["hasMilestones"] = false;
 174                 $message["milestones"] = [];
 175             }
 176 
 177 
 178             return $message;
 179         } else {
 180             return false;
 181         }
 182     }
 183 
 184     /**
 185      * Return all answers to a given message
 186      *
 187      * @param int $id Eindeutige Nummer der Nachricht
 188      * @return array $replies Antworten zur Nachricht
 189      */
 190     function getReplies($id)
 191     {
 192         global $conn;
 193         $id = (int)$id;
 194 
 195         $repliesStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT ID FROM messages WHERE replyto = ? ORDER BY posted DESC");
 196         $repliesStmt->execute(array($id));
 197 
 198         $replies = array();
 199 
 200         while ($reply = $repliesStmt->fetch()) {
 201             if (!empty($reply)) {
 202                 $replyMessage = $this->getMessage($reply["ID"]);
 203                 array_push($replies, $replyMessage);
 204                 //recursive call to get all replies to this reply
 205                 $this->getReplies($reply["ID"]);
 206             }
 207         }
 208         if (!empty($replies)) {
 209             return $replies;
 210         } else {
 211             return false;
 212         }
 213     }
 214 
 215     /**
 216      * Returns the most recent messages of a user, from the projects he is assigned to
 217      *
 218      * @param int $limit Limits the number of messages to return.
 219      * @return array $message Eigenschaften der Nachricht
 220      */
 221     function getLatestMessages($limit = 25)
 222     {
 223         global $conn;
 224         $limit = (int)$limit;
 225         // Get the id of the logged in user and get his projects
 226         $userid = $_SESSION["userid"];
 227         $userid = (int)$userid;
 228 
 229         $sel3 = $conn->query("SELECT projekt FROM projekte_assigned WHERE user = $userid");
 230         // Assemble a string of project IDs the user belongs to for IN() query.
 231         $prstring = "";
 232         while ($upro = $sel3->fetch()) {
 233             $projekt = $upro[0];
 234             $prstring .= $projekt . ",";
 235         }
 236 
 237         $prstring = substr($prstring, 0, strlen($prstring) - 1);
 238         if ($prstring) {
 239             $sel1 = $conn->query("SELECT ID FROM messages WHERE project IN($prstring) ORDER BY posted DESC LIMIT $limit ");
 240             $messages = array();
 241 
 242             while ($message = $sel1->fetch()) {
 243                 $themessage = $this->getMessage($message["ID"]);
 244                 array_push($messages, $themessage);
 245             }
 246         }
 247         if (!empty($messages)) {
 248             return $messages;
 249         } else {
 250             return false;
 251         }
 252     }
 253 
 254     /**
 255      * Returns all messages belonging to a project (excluding replies and personal messages).
 256      *
 257      * @param int $project Unique project number
 258      * @param int $limit Limit for the DB query
 259      * @param int $offset Offset for the DB query
 260      * @return array $messages Project messages
 261      */
 262     function getProjectMessages($project, $limit = 0, $offset = 0)
 263     {
 264         global $conn;

 266         $limit = (int)$limit;
 267         $offset = (int)$offset;
 268 
 269         $messages = array();
 270         if ($limit > 0) {

 272                   SELECT messages.ID FROM messages
 273                   LEFT JOIN messages_assigned ON messages.ID = messages_assigned.message
 274                   WHERE messages_assigned.message IS NULL
 275                   AND project = ?
 276                   AND replyto = 0
 277                   ORDER BY posted DESC
 278                   LIMIT $limit
 279                   OFFSET $offset");
 280 
 281         } else {
 282             $projectMessagesStmt = $conn->prepare("
 283                   SELECT messages.ID FROM messages
 284                   LEFT JOIN messages_assigned ON messages.ID = messages_assigned.message
 285                   WHERE messages_assigned.message IS NULL
 286                   AND project = ?
 287                   AND replyto = 0
 288                   ORDER BY posted DESC");
 289 
 290         }
 291 
 292         $projectMessagesStmt->execute(array($project));
 293 
 294         while ($messageId = $projectMessagesStmt->fetch()) {
 295             $message = $this->getMessage($messageId["ID"]);
 296             array_push($messages, $message);
 297         }
 298 
 299         if (!empty($messages)) {

 302             return false;

 344         $messages = array();
 345         $sel1 = $conn->prepare("
 346                   SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages
 347                   LEFT JOIN messages_assigned ON messages.ID = messages_assigned.message
 348                   WHERE messages_assigned.message IS NULL
 349                   AND project = ?
 350                   AND replyto = 0");
 351 
 352         $sel1->execute(array($project));
 353 
 354         $number = $sel1->fetch();
 355         $number = $number["COUNT(*)"];
 356 
 357         return $number;

 398      *
 399      * @param int $fileId ID of the file to be attached
 400      * @param int $messageId ID of the message where the file will be attached
 401      * @param int $project optional param denoting the project ID where the file will be uploaded to (if so)
 402      * @return bool
 403      */
 404     function attachFile($fileId, $messageId, $project = 0)
 405     {
 406         global $conn;
 407         $fileId = (int)$fileId;
 408         $messageId = (int)$messageId;
 409 
 410         // If a file ID is given, the given file will be attached
 411         // If no file ID is given, the file will be uploaded to the project defined by $id and then attached
 412         if ($fileId > 0) {
 413             $insStmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO files_attached (file,message) VALUES (?,?)");
 414             $ins = $insStmt->execute(array($fileId, $messageId));
 415         }
 416         if ($ins) {
 417             return true;
 418         } else {
 419             return false;

 423     /**
 424      * Get files attached to a message
 425      *
 426      * @param int $message ID of the message
 427      * @return array $files Attached files
 428      */
 429     private function getAttachedFiles($message)
 430     {
 431         global $conn;
 432         $message = (int)$message;
 433 
 434         $files = array();
 435         $attachedFilesStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT file FROM files_attached WHERE message = ?");
 436         $attachedFilesStmt->execute(array($message));
 437 
 438         //get systemSettings
 439         $settingsObj = new settings();
 440         $settings = $settingsObj->getSettings();
 441 
 442         while ($file = $attachedFilesStmt->fetch()) {
 443             $filesQuery = $conn->query("SELECT * FROM files WHERE ID = $file[0]");
 444             $thisfile = $filesQuery->fetch();
 445             $thisfile["type"] = str_replace("/", "-", $thisfile["type"]);
 446 
 447             // Construct the path to the MIME-type icon
 448             $myfile = "./templates/" . $settings["template"] . "/theme/" . $settings["theme"] . "/images/files/" . $thisfile['type'] . ".png";
 449             if (!file_exists($myfile)) {
 450                 $thisfile['type'] = "none";
 451             }
 452             // Determine if it is an image or text file or some other kind of file (required for lightbox)
 453             if (stristr($thisfile['type'], "image")) {
 454                 $thisfile['imgfile'] = 1;
 455             } elseif (stristr($thisfile['type'], "text")) {
 456                 $thisfile['imgfile'] = 2;
 457             } else {
 458                 $thisfile['imgfile'] = 0;
 459             }
 460 
 461             $thisfile["shortName"] = substr($thisfile["name"], 0, 12);
 462 
 463             array_push($files, $thisfile);
 464         }
 465 
 466         if (!empty($files)) {
 467             return $files;
 468         } else {
 469             return false;
 470         }
 471     }
 472 }

   3 /**
   4  * This class provides methods to realize milestones
   5  *
   6  * @author Philipp Kiszka <info@o-dyn.de>
   7  * @name milestone
   8  * @package Collabtive
   9  * @version 2.0
  10  * @link http://collabtive.o-dyn.de
  11  * @license http://opensource.org/licenses/gpl-license.php GNU General Public License v3 or later
  12  * @global $mylog
  13  */
  14 class milestone
  15 {
  16     /**
  17      * Add a milestone
  18      *
  19      * @param int $project ID of the associated project
  20      * @param string $name Name of the milestone
  21      * @param string $desc Description
  22      * @param string $end Day the milestone is due
  23      * @param int $status Status (0 = finished, 1 = open)
  24      * @return bool
  25      */
  26     function add($project, $name, $desc, $start, $end, $status = 1)
  27     {
  28         global $conn, $mylog;
  29         // Convert end date to timestamp
  30         $end = strtotime($end);
  31         $start = strtotime($start);
  32 
  33         $insStmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO milestones (`project`,`name`,`desc`,`start`,`end`,`status`) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
  34         $ins = $insStmt->execute(array((int)$project, $name, $desc, $start, $end, (int)$status));
  35 
  36         if ($ins) {
  37             $insid = $conn->lastInsertId();
  38             $mylog->add($name, 'milestone', 1, $project);
  39             return $insid;
  40         } else {
  41             return false;
  42         }
  43     }
  44 
  45     /**
  46      * Edit a milestone
  47      *
  48      * @param int $id Milestone ID
  49      * @param string $name Name
  50      * @param string $desc Description
  51      * @param string $endTime Day it is due
  52      * @return bool
  53      */
  54     function edit($id, $name, $desc, $start, $end)
  55     {
  56         global $conn, $mylog;
  57         $id = (int)$id;
  58         $startTime = strtotime($start);
  59         $endTime = strtotime($end);
  60 
  61         $updStmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE milestones SET `name`=?, `desc`=?, `start`=?, `end`=? WHERE ID=?");
  62         $upd = $updStmt->execute(array($name, $desc, $startTime, $endTime, $id));
  63         if ($upd) {
  64 
  65             $tasklistObj = new tasklist();
  66             $taskObj = new task();
  67 
  68             //get tasklists for the milestone
  69             $assignedTasklists = $this->getMilestoneTasklists($id);
  70 
  71             //loop tasklists
  72             foreach ($assignedTasklists as $assignedTasklist) {
  73                 //get tasks for this tasklist
  74                 $tasklistTasks = $tasklistObj->getTasksFromList($assignedTasklist["ID"]);
  75 
  76                 //edit the tasklist, set the name to the new milestoone new
  77                 $tasklistObj->edit_liste($assignedTasklist["ID"], $name, $desc, $assignedTasklist["milestone"]);
  78 
  79                 //loop tasks
  80                 foreach ($tasklistTasks as $tasklistTask) {
  81                     $assignees = $taskObj->getUsers($tasklistTask["ID"]);
  82                     //edit task and set start and end date to the new milestone start and end
  83                     $taskObj->edit($tasklistTask["ID"], $start, $end, $tasklistTask["title"], $tasklistTask["text"], $tasklistTask["liste"]);
  84                     foreach ($assignees as $assignee) {
  85                         $taskObj->assign($tasklistTask["ID"], $assignee["user"]);
  86                     }
  87                 }
  88             }
  89 
  90             $namStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT project,name FROM milestones WHERE ID = ?");
  91             $namStmt->execute(array($id));
  92             $nam = $namStmt->fetch();
  93 
  94             $project = $nam[0];
  95             $name = $nam[1];
  96 
  97             $mylog->add($name, 'milestone', 2, $project);
  98             return true;
  99         } else {
 100             return false;
 101         }
 102     }

 104     /**
 105      * Delete a milestone
 106      *
 107      * @param int $id Milestone ID
 108      * @return bool
 109      */
 110     function del($id)
 111     {
 112         global $conn, $mylog;
 113         $id = (int)$id;
 114 
 115         $del = $conn->query("DELETE FROM milestones WHERE ID = $id");
 116 
 117         if ($del) {
 118             $messageObj = new message();
 119             // delete message assignments
 120             $milestoneMessages = $this->getMilestoneMessages($id);
 121             if (!empty($milestoneMessages)) {
 122                 foreach ($milestoneMessages as $milestoneMessage) {
 123                     $messageObj->del($milestoneMessage["ID"]);
 124                 }
 125             }
 126 
 127             $tasklistObj = new tasklist();
 128             /*
 129              * Delete assigned tasklists
 130              */
 131             $milestoneTasklists = $this->getMilestoneTasklists($id);
 132             if (!empty($milestoneTasklists)) {
 133                 foreach ($milestoneTasklists as $milestoneTasklist) {
 134                     $tasklistObj->del_liste($milestoneTasklist["ID"]);
 135                 }
 136             }
 137             // delete user assignments
 138             $conn->query("DELETE FROM milestones_assigned WHERE milestone = $id");
 139 
 140             //get project and title of the milestone
 141             $namStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT project,name FROM milestones WHERE ID = ?");
 142             $namStmt->execute(array($id));
 143             $nam = $namStmt->fetch();
 144 
 145             $project = $nam[0];
 146             $name = $nam[1];
 147 
 148             $mylog->add($name, 'milestone', 3, $project);
 149 
 150             return true;
 151         } else {
 152             return false;
 153         }
 154     }

 286     /**
 287      * Return a milestone with its tasklists
 288      *
 289      * @param int $id Milestone ID
 290      * @return array $milestone Milestone details
 291      */
 292     function getMilestone($id)
 293     {
 294         global $conn;
 295         $id = (int)$id;
 296 
 297         $sel = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM milestones WHERE ID = ?");
 298         $sel->execute(array($id));
 299 
 300         $milestone = $sel->fetch();
 301 
 302         if (!empty($milestone)) {
 303             // Format start and end date for display
 304             $endstring = date(CL_DATEFORMAT, $milestone["end"]);
 305             $milestone["endstring"] = $endstring;
 306             $milestone["fend"] = $endstring;
 307 
 308             $startstring = date(CL_DATEFORMAT, $milestone["start"]);
 309             $milestone["startstring"] = $startstring;
 310 
 311             // Get the name of the project where the message was posted for display
 312             $projectNameQuery = $conn->query("SELECT name FROM projekte WHERE ID = $milestone[project]");
 313             $projectName = $projectNameQuery->fetch();
 314             $projectName = $projectName[0];
 315             $milestone["pname"] = $projectName;
 316 
 317             // Daysleft contains a signed number, dayslate an unsigned one that only applies if the milestone is late
 318             $dayslate = $this->getDaysLeft($milestone["end"]);
 319             $milestone["daysleft"] = $dayslate;
 320             $dayslate = str_replace("-", "", $dayslate);
 321             $milestone["dayslate"] = $dayslate;
 322 
 323             // Get attached tasklists and messages
 324             $tasks = $this->getMilestoneTasklists($milestone["ID"]);
 325             $milestone["tasklists"] = $tasks;
 326             $milestone["hasTasklist"] = false;
 327             if (count($tasks) > 0) {
 328                 $milestone["hasTasklist"] = true;
 329             }
 330             $messages = $this->getMilestoneMessages($milestone["ID"]);
 331             $milestone["messages"] = $messages;
 332             $milestone["hasMessages"] = false;
 333             if (count($messages) > 0) {
 334                 $milestone["hasMessages"] = true;
 335             }
 336 
 337             $assignedUserStmt = $conn->query("SELECT user FROM milestones_assigned WHERE milestone = $milestone[ID]");
 338 
 339             $users = array();
 340             // fetch the assigned user(s)
 341             while ($assignedUser = $assignedUserStmt->fetch()) {
 342                 // push the assigned users to an array
 343                 array_push($users, $assignedUser[0]);
 344                 $milestone["user"] = "All";
 345                 $milestone["user_id"] = $users;
 346             }
 347             $userObj = new user();
 348 
 349             if (count($users) == 1) {
 350                 // If only one user is assigned, get his profile and add him to users, user_id fields
 351                 $user = $userObj->getProfile($users[0]);
 352                 //if there is only one user, the user field contains the string with his name
 353                 $milestone["user"] = $user["name"];
 354                 //users contains an array with only the single user
 355                 $milestone["users"] = array($user);
 356                 //user id contains the id of the user
 357                 $milestone["user_id"] = $user["ID"];
 358             } elseif (count($users) > 1) {
 359                 // if there is more than one user push them to the users field. no user or user_id field is present.
 360                 $milestone["users"] = array();
 361                 $milestone["user"] = "";
 362                 $milestone["user_id"] = 0;
 363                 //loop through the users and push each one to the user array
 364                 foreach ($users as $assignedUser) {
 365                     $user = $userObj->getProfile($assignedUser);
 366                     $milestone["user"] .= $user["name"] . " ";
 367                     array_push($milestone["users"], $user);
 368                 }
 369             }
 370 
 371             return $milestone;
 372         } else {
 373             return false;
 374         }
 375     }

 601      * @return array $milestones Details of the milestones
 602      */
 603     function getTodayProjectMilestones($project, $lim = 100)
 604     {
 605         global $conn;
 606         $project = (int)$project;
 607         $lim = (int)$lim;
 608 
 609         $tod = date("d.m.Y");
 610         $now = strtotime($tod);
 611         $milestones = array();
 612 
 613         $sel1 = $conn->query("SELECT * FROM milestones WHERE project = $project AND end = '$now' AND status = 1 ORDER BY end ASC LIMIT $lim");
 614         while ($milestone = $sel1->fetch()) {
 615             $themilestone = $this->getMilestone($milestone["ID"]);
 616             array_push($milestones, $themilestone);
 617         }
 618 
 619         if (!empty($milestones)) {
 620             return $milestones;
 621         } else {
 622             return false;
 623         }
 624     }
 625 
 626     /**
 627      * Return all milestones of that belong to the loggedin user, due on a given day.
 628      *
 629      * This method is needed for populating the calendar widget with data.
 630      *
 631      * @param int $m Month Month, without leading zero (e.g. 5 for march)
 632      * @param int $y Year Year in format yyyy
 633      * @param int $d Day Without leading zero (e.g. 1 for the 1st of the month $m in year $y)
 634      * @return array $milestones Details of the milestones
 635      */
 636     function getTodayMilestones($m, $y, $d, $project = 0)
 637     {
 638         global $conn;
 639         $m = (int)$m;
 640         $y = (int)$y;
 641 
 642         if ($m > 9) {
 643             $startdate = date($d . "." . $m . "." . $y);
 644         } else {
 645             $startdate = date($d . ".0" . $m . "." . $y);
 646         }
 647         $starttime = strtotime($startdate);
 648         $user = (int)$_SESSION["userid"];
 649 
 650         $timeline = array();
 651 
 652         if ($project > 0) {
 653             $sel1 = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM milestones WHERE project =  ? AND status=1 AND end = '$starttime' ORDER BY `end` ASC");
 654             $sel1->execute(array($project));
 655         } else {
 656             $sel1 = $conn->prepare("SELECT milestones.*,projekte_assigned.user,projekte.name AS pname,projekte.status AS pstatus FROM milestones,projekte_assigned,projekte WHERE milestones.project = projekte_assigned.projekt AND milestones.project = projekte.ID AND projekte_assigned.user = ? AND milestones.status=1 AND projekte.status != 2 AND milestones.end = '$starttime'");
 657             $sel1->execute(array($user));
 658         }
 659         while ($stone = $sel1->fetch()) {
 660             $stone["daysleft"] = $this->getDaysLeft($stone["end"]);
 661             array_push($timeline, $stone);
 662         }
 663 
 664         if (!empty($timeline)) {
 665             return $timeline;
 666         } else {
 667             return array();
 668         }
 669     }
 670 
 671     /**
 672      * Return all open tasklists associated to a given milestones
 673      *
 674      * @param int $milestone Milestone ID
 675      * @return array $lists Details of the tasklists
 676      */
 677     function getMilestoneTasklists($milestone)
 678     {

 681

 683

 685         $lists = array();

 687             while ($listId = $sel->fetch()) {
 688                 array_push($lists, $objtasklist->getTasklist($listId["ID"]));
 689             }

 692             return $lists;

 698     private function getMilestoneMessages($milestone)
 699     {
 700         global $conn;
 701         $milestone = (int)$milestone;
 702         $sel = $conn->query("SELECT title,ID,milestone FROM messages WHERE milestone = $milestone");
 703         $msgs = array();

 706         }
 707         if (!empty($msgs)) {
 708             return $msgs;

 711 
 712     /**
 713      * Return the days left from today until a given point in time
 714      *
 715      * @param int $end Point in time
 716      * @return int $days Days left
 717      */
 718     private function getDaysLeft($end)
 719     {
 720         $tod = date("d.m.Y");
 721         $now = strtotime($tod);
 722         $diff = $end - $now;
 723         $days = floor($diff / 86400);
 724         return $days;
 725     }
 726 
 727     /**
 728      * Format a milestone's timestamp
 729      *
 730      * @param int $milestones Milestone ID
 731      * @param int $format Wanted time format
 732      * @return array $milestones Milestone with the formatted timestamp
 733      */
 734     function formatdate(array $milestones)
 735     {
 736         $cou = 0;
 737 
 738         if ($milestones) {
 739             foreach ($milestones as $stone) {
 740                 $datetime = date(CL_DATEFORMAT, $stone[5]);
 741                 $milestones[$cou]["due"] = $datetime;
 742                 $cou = $cou + 1;
 743             }
 744         }
 745 
 746         if (!empty($milestones)) {
 747             return $milestones;
 748         } else {
 749             return false;
 750         }
 751     }
 752 }

   3 /*
   4  * This class provides methods to realize the logging of different activities
   5  *
   6  * @author Philipp Kiszka <info@o-dyn.de>
   7  * @name mylog
   8  * @version 1.0
   9  * @package Collabtive
  10  * @link http://collabtive.o-dyn.de
  11  * @license http://opensource.org/licenses/gpl-license.php GNU General Public License v3 or later

  13 
  14 class mylog
  15 {
  16     /*
  17     * Constructor
  18     */
  19     function __construct()
  20     {
  21         $this->userid = getArrayVal($_SESSION, "userid");
  22         $this->uname = getArrayVal($_SESSION, "username");
  23     }
  24 
  25     /*
  26      * Add an event log entry
  27      *
  28      * @param string $name Name of the affected object
  29      * @param string $type Type of the affected object
  30      * @param int $action Action (1 = added, 2 = edited, 3 = deleted, 4 = opened, 5 = finished, 6 = assigned, 7 = deleted assignment)
  31      * @param int $project Project ID
  32      * @return bool
  33      */
  34     function add($name, $type, $action, $project)
  35     {
  36         global $conn;
  37         $user = $this->userid;
  38         $uname = $this->uname;
  39 
  40         $action = (int)$action;
  41         $project = (int)$project;
  42 
  43         $now = time();
  44 
  45         $insStmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO log (user,username,name,type,action,project,datum) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
  46         $ins = $insStmt->execute(array($user, $uname, $name, $type, $action, $project, $now));
  47         if ($ins) {
  48             $insid = $conn->lastInsertId();
  49             return $insid;
  50         } else {
  51             return false;
  52         }
  53     }
  54 
  55     /*
  56      * Delete an event log entry
  57      *
  58      * @param int $id Log entry ID
  59      * @return bool
  60      */
  61     function del($id)
  62     {
  63         global $conn;
  64         $id = (int)$id;
  65 
  66         $delStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM log WHERE ID = ?");
  67         $del = $delStmt->execute(array($id));
  68 
  69         if ($del) {
  70             return true;
  71         } else {
  72             return false;
  73         }
  74     }
  75 
  76     /*
  77      * Return all log entries associated with a given project
  78      *
  79      * @param int $project Project ID
  80      * @param int $limit Number of entries to return
  81      * @return array $mylog Log entries
  82      */
  83     function getProjectLog($project, $limit = 25, $offset = 0)
  84     {
  85         global $conn;
  86         $project = (int)$project;
  87         $limit = (int)$limit;
  88         $offset = (int)$offset;
  89 
  90         //get the logentries for the project
  91         $projectLogStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM log WHERE project = ? ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT $limit OFFSET $offset");
  92         $projectLogStmt->execute(array($project));
  93 
  94         $mylog = array();
  95         while ($log = $projectLogStmt->fetch()) {
  96             if (!empty($log)) {
  97                 //get the project name
  98                 $projectNameStmt = $conn->query("SELECT name FROM projekte WHERE ID = $log[project]");
  99 
 100                 $log["proname"] = $projectNameStmt->fetch()[0];
 101                 $log["name"] = stripslashes($log["name"]);
 102                 array_push($mylog, $log);
 103             }
 104         }
 105 
 106         if (!empty($mylog)) {
 107             return $mylog;
 108         } else {
 109             return false;
 110         }
 111     }
 112 
 113     /*
 114      * Return the log of the latest activities of a given user
 115      *
 116      * @param int $user User ID
 117      * @param int $limit Number of entries to return
 118      * @return array $mylog Latest entries
 119      */
 120     function getUserLog($user, $limit = 25)
 121     {
 122         global $conn;
 123         $user = (int)$user;
 124         $limit = (int)$limit;
 125 
 126         $userLogStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM log WHERE user = ? ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT ?");
 127         $userLogStmt->execute(array($user, $limit));
 128 
 129         $mylog = array();

 131             array_push($mylog, $log);
 132         }
 133 
 134         if (!empty($mylog)) {
 135             return $mylog;
 136         } else {
 137             return false;
 138         }
 139     }
 140 
 141     /*
 142      * Return the latest log entries
 143      *
 144      * @param int $limit Number of entries to return
 145      * @return array $mylog Latest entries
 146      */
 147     function getLog($limit = 5)
 148     {
 149         global $conn;
 150         $userid = $_SESSION["userid"];
 151         $limit = (int)$limit;
 152 
 153         $mylog = array();
 154         $userProjectsStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT projekt FROM projekte_assigned WHERE user = ?");
 155         $userProjectsStmt->execute(array($userid));
 156 
 157         //construct string of project names for use with IN()
 158         $prstring = "";
 159         while ($userProject = $userProjectsStmt->fetch()) {
 160             $projekt = $userProject[0];
 161             $prstring .= $projekt . ",";
 162         }
 163         $prstring = substr($prstring, 0, strlen($prstring) - 1);
 164 
 165         if ($prstring) {
 166             $sel = $conn->query("SELECT * FROM log  WHERE project IN($prstring) OR project = 0 ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT $limit");
 167 
 168             while ($log = $sel->fetch()) {
 169                 $projectNameStmt = $conn->query("SELECT name FROM projekte WHERE ID = $log[project]");
 170                 $log["proname"] = $projectNameStmt->fetch()[0];
 171 
 172                 array_push($mylog, $log);
 173             }
 174         }
 175 
 176         if (!empty($mylog)) {
 177             return $mylog;
 178         } else {
 179             return false;
 180         }
 181     }
 182 
 183     /*
 184      * Format the date of an entry
 185      *
 186      * @param int $log Log entry ID
 187      * @param string $format Wanted format
 188      * @return array $log Entry with the formatted time
 189      */
 190     function formatdate($log, $format = "")
 191     {
 192         if (!$format) {
 193             $format = CL_DATEFORMAT . " (H:i:s)";
 194         }
 195         $cou = 0;
 196 
 197         if ($log) {
 198             foreach ($log as $thelog) {
 199                 $datetime = date($format, $thelog[7]);
 200                 $log[$cou]["datum"] = $datetime;
 201                 $cou = $cou + 1;
 202             }
 203         }
 204 
 205         if (!empty($log)) {
 206             return $log;
 207         } else {
 208             return false;
 209         }
 210     }
 211 }

   2 
   3 /*
   4  * Class to list, install, enable, disable, etc plugins
   5  * @private string $installedPluginsPath path to the JSON file holding the installed plugins
   6  * @private array $installedPlugins arrays representing the installed plugins and their activation state
   7  */
   8 
   9 class pluginManager
  10 {
  11 
  12     private $installedPluginsPath;
  13     private $installedPlugins;
  14 
  15     /*
  16      * Constructor
  17      * Reads the installedPlugins.json
  18      */
  19     function __construct()
  20     {
  21         //set path to installedPlugins.json containing a JSON representation of the plugin configuration
  22         $this->installedPluginsPath = CL_ROOT . "/config/standard/installedPlugins.json";
  23 
  24         //read configuration file
  25         $installedPluginsFile = file_get_contents($this->installedPluginsPath);
  26         //decode json
  27         //each entry in this array is an array containing 2 fields: the plugin name and its activation state
  28         $this->installedPlugins = json_decode($installedPluginsFile);
  29     }
  30 
  31     /*
  32      * List all available plugins
  33      */
  34     function getPlugins()
  35     {
  36         return $this->installedPlugins;
  37     }
  38 
  39     /*
  40      * loop over the list of installed plugins and load them
  41      */
  42     function loadPlugins()
  43     {
  44         foreach ($this->installedPlugins as $plugin) {
  45             //plugin[1] is a bool indicating the activation state of the plugin
  46             if ($plugin[1]) {
  47                 //plugin[0] is the name of the plugin
  48                 $this->loadPlugin($plugin[0]);
  49             }
  50         }
  51         return;
  52     }
  53 
  54     /*
  55      * Load a plugin by calling  $activate();
  56      */
  57     function loadPlugin($thePlugin)
  58     {
  59         //call the constructor
  60         $plugin = new $thePlugin();
  61         //call bindPlugin()
  62         $plugin->activate();
  63         return true;
  64     }
  65 
  66     /*
  67      * Install a plugin
  68      * @param String $pluginName Unique Name of the plugin to be installed
  69      */
  70     function installPlugin($pluginName)
  71     {
  72         //add a new entry to the installed Plugins array, with an activation state of true
  73         array_push($this->installedPlugins, [$pluginName, true]);
  74         //refresh the config file
  75         $this->writePluginConfig($this->installedPlugins);
  76 
  77         return true;
  78     }
  79 
  80     /*
  81     * Set the state of a plugin
  82     * @param string $pluginName UniqueName of the plugin to be enabled
  83     * @param bool $pluginState true = enable, false = disable
  84     */
  85     function setPluginState($pluginName, $pluginState)
  86     {
  87         /*
  88         * Installed plugins is an array where each entry contains an array with 2 fields
  89         * 0 = name of the plugin
  90         * 1 = activation state (true / false)
  91         */
  92         foreach ($this->installedPlugins as &$installedPlugin) {
  93             //if the first field matches the name of the plugin to be enabled
  94             if ($installedPlugin[0] == $pluginName) {
  95                 //set its activation state to true
  96                 $installedPlugin[1] = $pluginState;
  97                 //refresh config file
  98                 $this->writePluginConfig($this->installedPlugins);
  99             }
 100         }
 101         return true;
 102     }
 103 
 104     /*
 105      * Helper function to manipulate the installedPlugins.json file
 106      * @param array $pluginConfig Array representing the configuration file to be written
 107      */
 108     private function writePluginConfig(array $pluginConfig)
 109     {
 110         //clear the template cache so templates get re-rerendered on next page load
 111         clearTemplateCache();
 112         //open file for reading and truncate to 0 length
 113         $fileHandle = fopen($this->installedPluginsPath, "w");
 114         //write JSON representation of the configuration array
 115         fwrite($fileHandle, json_encode($pluginConfig));
 116         //close file
 117         fclose($fileHandle);
 118         return true;
 119     }
 120 
 121     /*
 122      * Register a plugin with smarty
 123      * This registers a smarty {template tag} and connect it to a static method in the plugin class
 124      */
 125     function registerPlugin(array $templateTags, $pluginClassName)
 126     {
 127         global $template;
 128 
 129         //loop over tags
 130         foreach ($templateTags as $templateTag) {
 131             //if a tag has no method field, assume ::getTemplate method
 132             if (!isset($templateTag["method"]) || empty($templateTag["method"])) {
 133                 $templateTag["method"] = "::getMainTemplate";
 134             }
 135             //register with smarty
 136             $template->registerPlugin("function", $templateTag["tag"], $pluginClassName . $templateTag["method"]);
 137         }
 138         return true;
 139     }
 140 
 141     /*
 142      * Register smarty filters to replace <!--hooks--> with full {smarty tags}, associated to functions
 143      */
 144     function registerHook(array $filterFunctionNames)
 145     {
 146         global $template;
 147         //loop over filter functions and register a prefilter for each hook
 148         foreach ($filterFunctionNames as $filterFunctionName) {
 149             $template->registerFilter("pre", $filterFunctionName);
 150         }
 151 
 152         return true;
 153     }
 154 }

   3 /**
   4  * Die Klasse stellt Methoden bereit um Projekte zu bearbeiten
   5  *
   6  * @author Philipp Kiszka <info@o-dyn.de>
   7  * @name project
   8  * @package Collabtive
   9  * @version 3
  10  * @link http://collabtive.o-dyn.de
  11  * @license http://opensource.org/licenses/gpl-license.php GNU General Public License v3 or later
  12  */
  13 class project extends databaseModel
  14 {
  15     function __construct(){
  16         $this->databaseTable = "projekte";
  17     }
  18     /**
  19      * Add a project
  20      *
  21      * @param string $name Name des Projekts
  22      * @param string $desc Projektbeschreibung
  23      * @param string $end Date on which the project is due
  24      * @param float $budget Budget for this project
  25      * @param int $assignme Assign yourself to the project
  26      * @return int $insid ID des neu angelegten Projekts
  27      */
  28     function add($name, $desc, $end, $budget, $assignme = 0)
  29     {
  30         global $conn, $mylog;
  31 
  32         if ($end > 0) {
  33             $end = strtotime($end);
  34         }
  35 
  36         $now = time();
  37 
  38         $ins1Stmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO projekte (`name`, `desc`, `end`, `start`, `status`, `budget`) VALUES (?,?,?,?,1,?)");
  39         $ins1 = $ins1Stmt->execute(array($name, $desc, $end, $now, (float)$budget));
  40 
  41         $insid = $conn->lastInsertId();
  42         if ((int)$assignme == 1) {
  43             $uid = $_SESSION['userid'];
  44             $this->assign($uid, $insid);
  45         }
  46         if ($ins1) {
  47             mkdir(CL_ROOT . "/files/" . CL_CONFIG . "/$insid/", 0777);
  48             $mylog->add($name, 'projekt', 1, $insid);
  49             return $insid;
  50         } else {
  51             return false;
  52         }
  53     }
  54 
  55     function addProjectFromExcel($inputFileName)
  56     {
  57         include("./include/PHPExcel/IOFactory.php");
  58 
  59         $objReader = new PHPExcel_Reader_Excel2007();
  60 
  61         $objPHPExcel = $objReader->load($inputFileName);
  62         $sheetData = $objPHPExcel->getActiveSheet()->toArray(null, true, true, true);
  63 
  64         $limiter = "#";
  65 
  66         $projectObj = new project();
  67         $userObj = new user();
  68         $milestoneObj = new milestone();
  69         $tasklistObj = new tasklist();
  70         $taskObj = new task();
  71         $companyObj = new company();
  72 
  73         $projectname = $sheetData[2]["A"];
  74         $projectdescription = $sheetData[3]["A"];
  75         $projectdue = $sheetData[4]["A"];
  76         $projectbudget = $sheetData[5]["A"];
  77         $projectcustomer = $sheetData[6]["A"];
  78         $projectpriority = $sheetData[7]["A"];
  79 
  80         $projectId = $projectObj->add($projectname, $projectdescription, $projectdue, $projectbudget, $projectpriority);
  81 
  82         $customer = $companyObj->getCompanyByName($projectcustomer);
  83         if ($customer) {
  84             $companyObj->assign($customer["ID"], $projectId);
  85         }
  86 
  87         // USERS
  88         for ($i = 1; $i < count($sheetData); $i++) {
  89             $username = $sheetData[$i]["B"];
  90 
  91             if ($username) {
  92                 $user = $userObj->getUserByName($username);
  93 
  94                 if ($user) {
  95                     $projectObj->assign($user["ID"], $projectId);
  96                 }
  97             } else {
  98                 break;
  99             }
 100         }
 101         // MILESTONES
 102         for ($i = 1; $i < count($sheetData); $i++) {
 103             $milestone = explode($limiter, $sheetData[$i]["C"]);
 104 
 105             if ($milestone) {
 106                 $milestoneObj->add($projectId, $milestone[0], $milestone[1], $milestone[2], $milestone[3]);
 107             } else {
 108                 break;
 109             }
 110         }
 111         // TASK LISTS
 112         for ($i = 1; $i < count($sheetData); $i++) {
 113             $tasklist = explode($limiter, $sheetData[$i]["D"]);
 114 
 115             if ($tasklist) {
 116                 if ($tasklist[3]) {
 117                     $milestone = $milestoneObj->getMilestoneByName($tasklist[3]);
 118                     if ($milestone) {
 119                         $tasklistObj->add_liste($projectId, $tasklist[0], $tasklist[1], $tasklist[2], 0, $milestone["ID"]);
 120                     }
 121                 } else {
 122                     $tasklistObj->add_liste($projectId, $tasklist[0], $tasklist[1], $tasklist[2]);
 123                 }
 124             } else {
 125                 break;
 126             }
 127         }
 128         // TASKS
 129         for ($i = 1; $i < count($sheetData); $i++) {
 130             $task = explode($limiter, $sheetData[$i]["E"]);
 131 
 132             if ($task) {
 133                 $tasklist = $tasklistObj->getTasklistByName($task[5]);
 134                 {
 135                     $taskid = $taskObj->add($task[2], $task[3], $task[0], $task[4], $tasklist["ID"], $projectId, $task[6], $task[7]);
 136                 }
 137                 $user = $userObj->getUserByName($task[1]);
 138                 if ($taskid) {
 139                     if ($user) {
 140                         $taskObj->assign($taskid, $user["ID"]);
 141                     }
 142                 }
 143             } else {
 144                 break;
 145             }
 146         }
 147 
 148         return $projectId;
 149     }
 150 
 151     /**
 152      * Bearbeitet ein Projekt
 153      *
 154      * @param int $id Project ID
 155      * @param string $name Name of the project
 156      * @param string $desc Description of the project
 157      * @param string $end Date on which the project is due
 158      * @param int $customerID id of a customer
 159      * @return bool
 160      */
 161     function edit($id, $name, $desc, $end, $budget)
 162     {
 163         global $conn, $mylog;
 164         $end = strtotime($end);
 165         $id = (int)$id;
 166         $budget = (float)$budget;
 167         $name = htmlspecialchars($name);
 168 
 169         $updStmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE projekte SET name=?,`desc`=?,`end`=?,budget=? WHERE ID = ?");
 170         $upd = $updStmt->execute(array($name, $desc, $end, $budget, $id));
 171 
 172         if ($upd) {
 173             $mylog->add($name, 'projekt', 2, $id);
 174             return true;
 175         } else
 176             return false;
 177     }
 178 
 179     /**
 180      * Deletes a project including everything else that was assigned to it (e.g. Milestones, tasks, timetracker entries)
 181      *
 182      * @param int $id Project ID
 183      * @return bool
 184      */
 185     function del($id)
 186     {
 187         global $conn, $mylog;
 188         $userid = $_SESSION["userid"];
 189         $id = (int)$id;
 190         // Delete assignments of tasks of this project to users
 191         $task = new task();
 192         $tasks = $task->getProjectTasks($id);
 193         if (!empty($tasks)) {
 194             foreach ($tasks as $tas) {
 195                 $task->del($tas["ID"]);
 196             }
 197         }
 198         // Delete files and the assignments of these files to the messages they were attached to
 199         $fileObject = new datei();
 200         $files = $fileObject->getProjectFiles($id, 1000000);
 201         if (!empty($files)) {
 202             foreach ($files as $file) {
 203                 $fileObject->loeschen($file["ID"]);
 204             }
 205         }
 206 
 207         $del_messages = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM messages WHERE project = ?");
 208         $del_messages->execute(array($id));
 209 
 210         $del_milestones = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM milestones WHERE project = ?");
 211         $del_milestones->execute(array($id));
 212 
 213         $del_projectassignments = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM projekte_assigned WHERE projekt = ?");
 214         $del_projectassignments->execute(array($id));
 215 
 216         $del_tasklists = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM tasklist WHERE project = ?");
 217         $del_tasklists->execute(array($id));
 218 
 219         $del_tasks = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE project = ?");
 220         $del_tasks->execute(array($id));
 221 
 222         $del_timetracker = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM timetracker WHERE project = ?");
 223         $del_timetracker->execute(array($id));
 224 
 225         $del_customer = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM customers_assigned WHERE project = ?");
 226         $del_customer->execute(array($id));
 227 
 228         $del_logentries = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM log WHERE project = ?");
 229         $del_logentries->execute(array($id));
 230 
 231         $del = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM projekte WHERE ID = ?");
 232         $delchk = $del->execute(array($id));
 233 
 234         delete_directory(CL_ROOT . "/files/" . CL_CONFIG . "/$id");
 235         if ($delchk) {
 236             $mylog->add($userid, 'projekt', 3, $id);
 237             return true;

 239             return false;

 267     /**
 268      * Marks a project, its tasks, tasklists and milestones as "finished / closed"
 269      *
 270      * @param int $id Eindeutige Projektnummer
 271      * @return bool
 272      */
 273     function close($id)
 274     {
 275         global $conn, $mylog;
 276         $id = (int)$id;
 277 
 278         /*
 279          * Close projectt milestones
 280          */
 281         $mile = new milestone();
 282         $milestones = $mile->getAllProjectMilestones($id, 100000);
 283         if (!empty($milestones)) {
 284             $close_milestones = $conn->prepare("UPDATE milestones SET status = 0 WHERE ID = ?");
 285             foreach ($milestones as $miles) {
 286                 $close_milestones->execute(array($miles["ID"]));
 287             }
 288         }
 289 
 290         /*
 291          * Close tasklists
 292          */
 293         $tasklistObj = new tasklist();
 294         $tasklists = $tasklistObj->getProjectTasklists($id);
 295         if (!empty($tasklists)) {
 296             $close_tasklists = $conn->prepare("UPDATE tasklist SET status = 0 WHERE ID = ?");
 297             foreach ($tasklists as $tasklist) {
 298                 $close_tasklists->execute(array($tasklist["ID"]));
 299             }
 300         }
 301 
 302         /*
 303          * Close tasks
 304          */
 305         $taskObj = new task();
 306         $tasks = $taskObj->getProjectTasks($id);
 307         if (!empty($tasks)) {
 308             $close_tasks = $conn->prepare("UPDATE tasks SET status = 0 WHERE ID = ?");
 309             foreach ($tasks as $task) {
 310                 $close_tasks->execute(array($task["ID"]));
 311             }
 312         }
 313 
 314         /*
 315          * Close project
 316          */
 317         $updStmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE projekte SET status=0 WHERE ID = ?");
 318         $upd = $updStmt->execute(array($id));
 319 
 320         if ($upd) {
 321             $nam = $conn->query("SELECT name FROM projekte WHERE ID = $id")->fetch();
 322             $nam = $nam[0];
 323             $mylog->add($nam, 'projekt', 5, $id);
 324             return true;
 325         } else {
 326             return false;
 327         }
 328     }

 353     /**
 354      * Removes a user from a project
 355      *
 356      * @param int $user User ID of user to remove
 357      * @param int $id Project ID of project to remove from
 358      * @return bool
 359      */
 360     function deassign($user, $id)
 361     {
 362         global $conn, $mylog;
 363 
 364         $sqlStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM projekte_assigned WHERE user = ? AND projekt = ?");
 365 
 366         $milestone = new milestone();
 367         // Delete the users assignments to closed milestones
 368         $doneMilestones = $milestone->getDoneProjectMilestones($id);
 369         if (!empty($doneMilestones)) {
 370             $doneMilestonesStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM milestones_assigned WHERE user = ? AND milestone = ?");
 371             foreach ($doneMilestones as $dm) {
 372                 $doneMilestonesStmt->execute(array((int)$user, $dm['ID']));
 373             }
 374         }
 375         // Delete the users assignments to open milestones
 376         $openMilestones = $milestone->getAllProjectMilestones($id, 100000);
 377         if (!empty($openMilestones)) {
 378             $openMilestonesStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM milestones_assigned WHERE user = ? AND milestone = ?");
 379             foreach ($openMilestones as $openMilestone) {
 380                 $openMilestonesStmt->execute(array((int)$user, $openMilestone['ID']));
 381             }
 382         }
 383 
 384         $taskObj = new task();
 385         $tasks = $taskObj->getProjectTasks($id);
 386         // Delete tasks assignments of the user
 387         if (!empty($tasks)) {
 388             $tasksStmt = $conn->prepare("DELETE FROM tasks_assigned WHERE user = ? AND task = ?");
 389             foreach ($tasks as $task) {
 390                 $tasksStmt->execute(array((int)$user, $task['ID']));
 391             }
 392         }
 393         // Finally remove the user from the project
 394         $del = $sqlStmt->execute(array((int)$user, (int)$id));
 395         if ($del) {
 396             $userObj = new user();
 397             $user = $userObj->getProfile($user);
 398             $mylog->add($user["name"], 'user', 7, $id);
 399             return true;
 400         } else {
 401             return false;
 402         }
 403     }

 405     /**
 406      * Gibt alle Daten eines Projekts aus
 407      *
 408      * @param int $id Eindeutige Projektnummer
 409      * @return array $project Projektdaten
 410      */
 411     function getProject($id)
 412     {
 413         $id = (int)$id;
 414         $project = $this->getElement($id);
 415 
 416         if (!empty($project)) {
 417             if ($project["end"]) {
 418                 $daysleft = $this->getDaysLeft($project["end"]);
 419                 $project["daysleft"] = $daysleft;
 420 
 421                 /*
 422                  * Determine if project is late or is today
 423                  * This is for display
 424                  */
 425                 $project["islate"] = false;
 426                 if ($project["daysleft"] < 1) {
 427                     $project["islate"] = true;
 428                 }
 429 
 430                 $project["istoday"] = false;
 431                 if ($project["daysleft"] == 0) {
 432                     $project["istoday"] = true;
 433                 }
 434 
 435                 //Format endstring according to system dateformat
 436                 $project["endstring"] = date(CL_DATEFORMAT, $project["end"]);
 437             } else {
 438                 $project["daysleft"] = "";
 439             }
 440 
 441             $project["startstring"] = date(CL_DATEFORMAT, $project["start"]);
 442 
 443             $project["done"] = $this->getProgress($project["ID"]);
 444 
 445             $companyObj = new company();
 446             $project["customer"] = $companyObj->getProjectCompany($id);
 447 
 448             return $project;
 449         } else {
 450             return false;
 451         }
 452     }

 454     /**
 455      * List projectts
 456      *
 457      * @param int $status Status of the project (1=open, 2= closed)
 458      * @param int $limit Anzahl der anzuzeigenden Projekte
 459      * @param int offset The offset from which to fetch data from
 460      * @return array $projekte Active projects
 461      */
 462     function getProjects($status = 1, $limit = 10, $offset = 0)
 463     {
 464         global $conn;
 465 
 466         $status = (int)$status;
 467         $limit = (int)$limit;
 468         $offset = (int)$offset;
 469 
 470         $projects = array();
 471 
 472         $projectIdStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT `ID` FROM projekte WHERE `status`= ? ORDER BY `end` ASC LIMIT $limit OFFSET $offset");
 473         $projectIdStmt->execute(array($status));
 474 
 475         while ($projectId = $projectIdStmt->fetch()) {
 476             array_push($projects, $this->getProject($projectId["ID"]));
 477         }
 478 
 479         if (!empty($projects)) {
 480             return $projects;
 481         } else {
 482             return false;
 483         }
 484     }

 489      *

 492      * @param int $limit Limit for the SQL statement
 493      * @param int $offset Offset for the SQL statement
 494      * @return array $myProjects Projects for this user
 495      */
 496     function getMyProjects($user, $status = 1, $offset = 0, $limit = 10)
 497     {
 498         global $conn;
 499 
 500         $myProjects = array();
 501         $user = (int)$user;
 502         $status = (int)$status;
 503         $offset = (int)$offset;
 504         $limit = (int)$limit;
 505         //get the projekt IDs of projects assigned to this user
 506         $selAssigned = $conn->query("SELECT projekt, status FROM projekte_assigned JOIN projekte ON projekte.ID = projekte_assigned.projekt WHERE user = $user AND projekte.status = $status ORDER BY projekt DESC LIMIT $limit OFFSET $offset");
 507 
 508         $projectsAssigned = $selAssigned->fetchAll();
 509 
 510         //loop by reference and assign the project details to eahc project
 511         foreach ($projectsAssigned as $project) {
 512             if (!empty($project[0])) {
 513                 array_push($myProjects,$this->getProject($project[0]));

 515         }
 516 
 517         if (!empty($myProjects)) {
 518             return $myProjects;
 519         } else {
 520             return false;
 521         }
 522     }

 663     /**
 664      * Progressmeter
 665      *
 666      * @param int $project Project ID
 667      * @return array $done Percent of finished tasks
 668      */
 669     function getProgress($project)
 670     {
 671         global $conn;
 672         $project = (int)$project;
 673 
 674         $openTasksStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE project = ? AND status = 1");
 675         $openTasksStmt->execute(array($project));
 676 
 677         $openTasks = $openTasksStmt->fetch();
 678         $openTasks = $openTasks[0];
 679 
 680         $closedTasksStmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE project = ? AND status = 0");
 681         $closedTasksStmt->execute(array($project));
 682 
 683         $closedTasks = $closedTasksStmt->fetch();
 684         $closedTasks = $closedTasks[0];
 685 
 686         $totaltasks = $openTasks + $closedTasks;
 687         if ($totaltasks > 0 and $closedTasks > 0) {
 688             $done = $closedTasks / $totaltasks * 100;
 689             $done = round($done);
 690         } else {
 691             $done = 0;
 692         }
 693         return $done;
 694     }

 722     /**
 723      * Get days until a specified date
 724      *
 725      * @param int $end End date to compare with
 726      * @return int Remaining days
 727      */
 728     private function getDaysLeft($end)
 729     {
 730         $tod = date("d.m.Y");
 731         $start = strtotime($tod);
 732         $diff = $end - $start;
 733         return floor($diff / 86400);
 734     }
 735 }

  33     function add($name, array $projects, array $tasks, array $milestones, array $messages, array $files, array $timetracker, array $chat, array $admin)

  46         $ins = $insStmt->execute(array($name, $projects, $tasks, $milestones, $messages, $files, $timetracker, $chat, $admin));
  47 
  48         if ($ins) {
  49             $insid = $conn->lastInsertId();

  74     function edit($id, $name, array $projects, array $tasks, array $milestones, array $messages, array $files, array $timetracker, array $chat, array $admin)

 122     /**
 123      * Assign a role to a user
 124      * Assigns role $role to user $user
 125      *
 126      * @param int $role ID of the role
 127      * @param int $user ID of the user
 128      * @return bool
 129      */
 130     function assign($role, $user)
 131     {
 132         global $conn;
 133         $role = (int) $role;
 134         $user = (int) $user;
 135         // get the number of roles already assigned to $user
 136         $chk = $conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roles_assigned WHERE user = $user")->fetch();
 137         $chk = $chk[0];
 138         // If there already is a role assigned to the user, just update this entry
 139         // Otherwise create a new entry
 140         if ($chk > 0) {
 141             $insStmt = $conn->prepare("UPDATE roles_assigned SET role = ? WHERE user = ?");
 142             $ins = $insStmt->execute(array($role, $user));
 143         } else {
 144             $insStmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO roles_assigned (user,role) VALUES (?,?)");
 145             $ins = $insStmt->execute(array($user, $role));
 146         }
 147 
 148         if ($ins) {
 149             return true;
 150         } else {
 151             return false;
 152         }
 153     }

 275     function sanitizeArray($inarr)

 282         }
 283         if (empty($inarr["edit"])) {

 286         if (empty($inarr["del"])) {

 288         }

 290             $inarr["close"] = 0;
 291         }
