   2 /**
   3  * Smarty Internal Plugin Compile ForeachSection
   4  * Shared methods for {foreach} {section} tags
   5  *
   6  * @package    Smarty
   7  * @subpackage Compiler
   8  * @author     Uwe Tews
   9  */
  10 
  11 /**
  12  * Smarty Internal Plugin Compile ForeachSection Class
  13  *
  14  * @package    Smarty
  15  * @subpackage Compiler
  16  */
  17 class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_ForeachSection extends Smarty_Internal_CompileBase
  18 {
  19 
  20     /**
  21      * Preg search pattern
  22      *
  23      * @var string
  24      */
  25     private $propertyPreg = '';
  26 
  27     /**
  28      * Offsets in preg match result
  29      *
  30      * @var array
  31      */
  32     private $resultOffsets = array();
  33 
  34     /**
  35      * Start offset
  36      *
  37      * @var int
  38      */
  39     private $startOffset = 0;
  40 
  41     /**
  42      * Name of this tag
  43      *
  44      * @var string
  45      */
  46     public $tagName = '';
  47 
  48     /**
  49      * Valid properties of $smarty.xxx variable
  50      *
  51      * @var array
  52      */
  53     public $nameProperties = array();
  54 
  55     /**
  56      * {section} tag has no item properties
  57      *
  58      * @var array
  59      */
  60     public $itemProperties = null;
  61 
  62     /**
  63      * {section} tag has always name attribute
  64      *
  65      * @var bool
  66      */
  67     public $isNamed = true;
  68 
  69     /**
  70      * @var array
  71      */
  72     public $matchResults = array();
  73 
  74     /**
  75      * Scan sources for used tag attributes
  76      *
  77      * @param  array                                $attributes
  78      * @param \Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler
  79      */
  80     public function scanForProperties($attributes, Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler)
  81     {
  82         $this->propertyPreg = '~(';
  83         $this->startOffset = 0;
  84         $this->resultOffsets = array();
  85         $this->matchResults = array('named' => array(), 'item' => array());
  86         if ($this->isNamed) {
  87             $this->buildPropertyPreg(true, $attributes);
  88         }
  89         if (isset($this->itemProperties)) {
  90             if ($this->isNamed) {
  91                 $this->propertyPreg .= '|';
  92             }
  93             $this->buildPropertyPreg(false, $attributes);
  94         }
  95         $this->propertyPreg .= ')\W~i';
  96         // Template source
  97         $this->matchTemplateSource($compiler);
  98         // Parent template source
  99         $this->matchParentTemplateSource($compiler);
 100         // {block} source
 101         $this->matchBlockSource($compiler);
 102     }
 103 
 104     /**
 105      * Build property preg string
 106      *
 107      * @param bool  $named
 108      * @param array $attributes
 109      */
 110     public function buildPropertyPreg($named, $attributes)
 111     {
 112         if ($named) {
 113             $this->resultOffsets['named'] = $this->startOffset + 3;
 114             $this->propertyPreg .= "([\$]smarty[.]{$this->tagName}[.]{$attributes['name']}[.](";
 115             $properties = $this->nameProperties;
 116         } else {
 117             $this->resultOffsets['item'] = $this->startOffset + 3;
 118             $this->propertyPreg .= "([\$]{$attributes['item']}[@](";
 119             $properties = $this->itemProperties;
 120         }
 121         $this->startOffset += count($properties) + 2;
 122         $propName = reset($properties);
 123         while ($propName) {
 124             $this->propertyPreg .= "({$propName})";
 125             $propName = next($properties);
 126             if ($propName) {
 127                 $this->propertyPreg .= '|';
 128             }
 129         }
 130         $this->propertyPreg .= '))';
 131     }
 132 
 133     /**
 134      * Find matches in source string
 135      *
 136      * @param string $source
 137      */
 138     public function matchProperty($source)
 139     {
 140         preg_match_all($this->propertyPreg, $source, $match, PREG_SET_ORDER);
 141         foreach ($this->resultOffsets as $key => $offset) {
 142             foreach ($match as $m) {
 143                 if (isset($m[$offset]) && !empty($m[$offset])) {
 144                     $this->matchResults[$key][strtolower($m[$offset])] = true;
 145                 }
 146             }
 147         }
 148     }
 149 
 150     /**
 151      * Find matches in template source
 152      *
 153      * @param \Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler
 154      */
 155     public function matchTemplateSource(Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler)
 156     {
 157         $this->matchProperty($compiler->parser->lex->data);
 158     }
 159 
 160     /**
 161      * Find matches in all parent template source
 162      *
 163      * @param \Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler
 164      */
 165     public function matchParentTemplateSource(Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler)
 166     {
 167         // search parent compiler template source
 168         $nextCompiler = $compiler;
 169         while ($nextCompiler !== $nextCompiler->parent_compiler) {
 170             $nextCompiler = $nextCompiler->parent_compiler;
 171             if ($compiler !== $nextCompiler) {
 172                 // get template source
 173                 $_content = $nextCompiler->template->source->getContent();
 174                 if ($_content != '') {
 175                     // run pre filter if required

   2 /**

  10 /**
  11  * This class does extend all internal compile plugins
  12  *
  13  * @package    Smarty
  14  * @subpackage Compiler
  15  */
  16 abstract class Smarty_Internal_CompileBase
  17 {
  18     /**
  19      * Array of names of required attribute required by tag
  20      *
  21      * @var array
  22      */
  23     public $required_attributes = array();
  24 
  25     /**
  26      * Array of names of optional attribute required by tag
  27      * use array('_any') if there is no restriction of attributes names
  28      *
  29      * @var array
  30      */
  31     public $optional_attributes = array();
  32 
  33     /**
  34      * Shorttag attribute order defined by its names
  35      *
  36      * @var array
  37      */
  38     public $shorttag_order = array();
  39 
  40     /**
  41      * Array of names of valid option flags
  42      *
  43      * @var array
  44      */
  45     public $option_flags = array('nocache');
  46 
  47     /**
  48      * This function checks if the attributes passed are valid
  49      * The attributes passed for the tag to compile are checked against the list of required and
  50      * optional attributes. Required attributes must be present. Optional attributes are check against
  51      * the corresponding list. The keyword '_any' specifies that any attribute will be accepted
  52      * as valid
  53      *
  54      * @param  object $compiler   compiler object
  55      * @param  array  $attributes attributes applied to the tag
  56      *
  57      * @return array  of mapped attributes for further processing
  58      */
  59     public function getAttributes($compiler, $attributes)
  60     {
  61         $_indexed_attr = array();
  62         // loop over attributes
  63         foreach ($attributes as $key => $mixed) {
  64             // shorthand ?
  65             if (!is_array($mixed)) {
  66                 // option flag ?
  67                 if (in_array(trim($mixed, '\'"'), $this->option_flags)) {
  68                     $_indexed_attr[trim($mixed, '\'"')] = true;
  69                     // shorthand attribute ?
  70                 } elseif (isset($this->shorttag_order[$key])) {
  71                     $_indexed_attr[$this->shorttag_order[$key]] = $mixed;
  72                 } else {
  73                     // too many shorthands
  74                     $compiler->trigger_template_error('too many shorthand attributes', null, true);
  75                 }
  76                 // named attribute
  77             } else {
  78                 $kv = each($mixed);
  79                 // option flag?
  80                 if (in_array($kv['key'], $this->option_flags)) {
  81                     if (is_bool($kv['value'])) {
  82                         $_indexed_attr[$kv['key']] = $kv['value'];
  83                     } elseif (is_string($kv['value']) && in_array(trim($kv['value'], '\'"'), array('true', 'false'))) {
  84                         if (trim($kv['value']) == 'true') {
  85                             $_indexed_attr[$kv['key']] = true;
  86                         } else {
  87                             $_indexed_attr[$kv['key']] = false;
  88                         }
  89                     } elseif (is_numeric($kv['value']) && in_array($kv['value'], array(0, 1))) {
  90                         if ($kv['value'] == 1) {
  91                             $_indexed_attr[$kv['key']] = true;
  92                         } else {
  93                             $_indexed_attr[$kv['key']] = false;
  94                         }
  95                     } else {
  96                         $compiler->trigger_template_error("illegal value of option flag \"{$kv['key']}\"", null, true);
  97                     }
  98                     // must be named attribute
  99                 } else {
 100                     reset($mixed);
 101                     $_indexed_attr[key($mixed)] = $mixed[key($mixed)];
 102                 }
 103             }
 104         }
 105         // check if all required attributes present
 106         foreach ($this->required_attributes as $attr) {
 107             if (!array_key_exists($attr, $_indexed_attr)) {
 108                 $compiler->trigger_template_error("missing \"" . $attr . "\" attribute", null, true);
 109             }
 110         }
 111         // check for not allowed attributes
 112         if ($this->optional_attributes != array('_any')) {
 113             $tmp_array = array_merge($this->required_attributes, $this->optional_attributes, $this->option_flags);
 114             foreach ($_indexed_attr as $key => $dummy) {
 115                 if (!in_array($key, $tmp_array) && $key !== 0) {
 116                     $compiler->trigger_template_error("unexpected \"" . $key . "\" attribute", null, true);
 117                 }
 118             }
 119         }
 120         // default 'false' for all option flags not set
 121         foreach ($this->option_flags as $flag) {
 122             if (!isset($_indexed_attr[$flag])) {
 123                 $_indexed_attr[$flag] = false;
 124             }
 125         }
 126 
 127         return $_indexed_attr;
 128     }
 129 
 130     /**
 131      * Push opening tag name on stack
 132      * Optionally additional data can be saved on stack
 133      *
 134      * @param object $compiler compiler object
 135      * @param string $openTag  the opening tag's name
 136      * @param mixed  $data     optional data saved
 137      */
 138     public function openTag($compiler, $openTag, $data = null)
 139     {
 140         array_push($compiler->_tag_stack, array($openTag, $data));
 141     }
 142 
 143     /**
 144      * Pop closing tag
 145      * Raise an error if this stack-top doesn't match with expected opening tags
 146      *
 147      * @param  object       $compiler    compiler object
 148      * @param  array|string $expectedTag the expected opening tag names
 149      *
 150      * @return mixed        any type the opening tag's name or saved data
 151      */
 152     public function closeTag($compiler, $expectedTag)
 153     {
 154         if (count($compiler->_tag_stack) > 0) {
 155             // get stacked info
 156             list($_openTag, $_data) = array_pop($compiler->_tag_stack);
 157             // open tag must match with the expected ones
 158             if (in_array($_openTag, (array) $expectedTag)) {
 159                 if (is_null($_data)) {
 160                     // return opening tag
 161                     return $_openTag;
 162                 } else {
 163                     // return restored data
 164                     return $_data;
 165                 }
 166             }
 167             // wrong nesting of tags
 168             $compiler->trigger_template_error("unclosed {$compiler->smarty->left_delimiter}" . $_openTag .
 169                                               "{$compiler->smarty->right_delimiter} tag");
 170 
 171             return;
 172         }
 173         // wrong nesting of tags
 174         $compiler->trigger_template_error("unexpected closing tag", null, true);
 175 
 176         return;
 177     }
 178 }

 124         if ($this->smarty->_parserdebug) {
 125             $parser->PrintTrace();
 126         }
 127         // get tokens from lexer and parse them
 128         while ($lex->yylex()) {
 129             if ($this->smarty->_parserdebug) {
 130                 echo "<br>Parsing  {$parser->yyTokenName[$lex->token]} Token {$lex->value} Line {$lex->line} \n";
 131             }
 132             $parser->doParse($lex->token, $lex->value);
 133         }
 134         // finish parsing process
 135         $parser->doParse(0, 0);
 136 
 137         if ($mbEncoding) {
 138             mb_internal_encoding($mbEncoding);
 139         }
 140         if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 141             $this->smarty->_debug->end_compile($this->template);
 142         }
 143         // template header code
 144         $template_header = "<?php /* Smarty version " . Smarty::SMARTY_VERSION . ", created on " .
 145             strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") . "\n";
 146         $template_header .= "         compiled from \"" . $this->template->source->filepath . "\" */ ?>\n";
 147 
 148         $code = '<?php $_smarty_tpl->smarty->ext->configLoad->_loadConfigVars($_smarty_tpl, ' .
 149             var_export($this->config_data, true) . '); ?>';
 150         return $template_header . $this->template->smarty->ext->_codeFrame->create($this->template, $code);
 151     }
 152 
 153     /**
 154      * display compiler error messages without dying
 155      * If parameter $args is empty it is a parser detected syntax error.
 156      * In this case the parser is called to obtain information about expected tokens.
 157      * If parameter $args contains a string this is used as error message
 158      *
 159      * @param string $args individual error message or null
 160      *
 161      * @throws SmartyCompilerException
 162      */
 163     public function trigger_config_file_error($args = null)
 164     {
 165         $this->lex = Smarty_Internal_Configfilelexer::instance();
 166         $this->parser = Smarty_Internal_Configfileparser::instance();
 167         // get config source line which has error
 168         $line = $this->lex->line;
 169         if (isset($args)) {
 170             // $line--;
 171         }
 172         $match = preg_split("/\n/", $this->lex->data);
 173         $error_text = "Syntax error in config file '{$this->template->source->filepath}' on line {$line} '{$match[$line - 1]}' ";
 174         if (isset($args)) {
 175             // individual error message
 176             $error_text .= $args;
 177         } else {
 178             // expected token from parser
 179             foreach ($this->parser->yy_get_expected_tokens($this->parser->yymajor) as $token) {
 180                 $exp_token = $this->parser->yyTokenName[$token];
 181                 if (isset($this->lex->smarty_token_names[$exp_token])) {
 182                     // token type from lexer
 183                     $expect[] = '"' . $this->lex->smarty_token_names[$exp_token] . '"';
 184                 } else {
 185                     // otherwise internal token name
 186                     $expect[] = $this->parser->yyTokenName[$token];
 187                 }
 188             }
 189             // output parser error message
 190             $error_text .= ' - Unexpected "' . $this->lex->value . '", expected one of: ' . implode(' , ', $expect);
 191         }
 192         throw new SmartyCompilerException($error_text);
 193     }
 194 }

  29     protected function buildFilepath(Smarty_Template_Source $source, Smarty_Internal_Template $_template = null)

  31         $file = $source->name;
  32         // absolute file ?
  33         if ($file[0] == '/' || $file[1] == ':') {
  34             $file = $source->smarty->_realpath($file, true);
  35             return is_file($file) ? $file : false;
  36         }
  37         // go relative to a given template?
  38         if ($file[0] == '.' && $_template && isset($_template->parent) && $_template->parent->_objType == 2 &&
  39             preg_match('#^[.]{1,2}[\\\/]#', $file)

  41             if ($_template->parent->source->type != 'file' && $_template->parent->source->type != 'extends' &&
  42                 !isset($_template->parent->_cache['allow_relative_path'])
  43             ) {
  44                 throw new SmartyException("Template '{$file}' cannot be relative to template of resource type '{$_template->parent->source->type}'");
  45             }
  46             $path = dirname($_template->parent->source->filepath) . DS . $file;
  47             // normalize path
  48             $path = $source->smarty->_realpath($path);
  49             // files relative to a template only get one shot
  50             return is_file($path) ? $path : false;
  51         }
  52         // normalize DS
  53         if (strpos($file, DS == '/' ? '\\' : '/') !== false) {
  54             $file = str_replace(DS == '/' ? '\\' : '/', DS, $file);
  55         }
  56 
  57         $_directories = $source->smarty->getTemplateDir(null, $source->isConfig);
  58         // template_dir index?
  59         if ($file[0] == '[' && preg_match('#^\[([^\]]+)\](.+)$#', $file, $fileMatch)) {
  60             $file = $fileMatch[2];
  61             $_indices = explode(',', $fileMatch[1]);
  62             $_index_dirs = array();
  63             foreach ($_indices as $index) {
  64                 $index = trim($index);
  65                 // try string indexes
  66                 if (isset($_directories[$index])) {
  67                     $_index_dirs[] = $_directories[$index];
  68                 } elseif (is_numeric($index)) {
  69                     // try numeric index
  70                     $index = (int) $index;
  71                     if (isset($_directories[$index])) {
  72                         $_index_dirs[] = $_directories[$index];
  73                     } else {
  74                         // try at location index
  75                         $keys = array_keys($_directories);
  76                         if (isset($_directories[$keys[$index]])) {
  77                             $_index_dirs[] = $_directories[$keys[$index]];
  78                         }
  79                     }
  80                 }
  81             }
  82             if (empty($_index_dirs)) {
  83                 // index not found
  84                 return false;
  85             } else {
  86                 $_directories = $_index_dirs;
  87             }
  88         }
  89 
  90         // relative file name?
  91         foreach ($_directories as $_directory) {
  92             $path = $_directory . $file;

  11 class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_ValidateCompiled
  12 {
  13     /**
  14      * This function is executed automatically when a compiled or cached template file is included
  15      * - Decode saved properties from compiled template and cache files
  16      * - Check if compiled or cache file is valid
  17      *
  18      * @param  array $properties special template properties
  19      * @param  bool  $cache      flag if called from cache file
  20      *
  21      * @return bool  flag if compiled or cache file is valid
  22      */
  23     public function decodeProperties(Smarty_Internal_Template $tpl, $properties, $cache = false)
  24     {
  25         $is_valid = true;
  26         if (Smarty::SMARTY_VERSION != $properties['version']) {
  27             // new version must rebuild
  28             $is_valid = false;
  29         } elseif ($is_valid && !empty($properties['file_dependency']) &&
  30             ((!$cache && $tpl->smarty->compile_check) || $tpl->smarty->compile_check == 1)
  31         ) {
  32             // check file dependencies at compiled code
  33             foreach ($properties['file_dependency'] as $_file_to_check) {
  34                 if ($_file_to_check[2] == 'file' || $_file_to_check[2] == 'extends' || $_file_to_check[2] == 'php') {
  35                     if ($tpl->source->filepath == $_file_to_check[0]) {
  36                         // do not recheck current template
  37                         continue;
  38                         //$mtime = $tpl->source->getTimeStamp();
  39                     } else {
  40                         // file and php types can be checked without loading the respective resource handlers
  41                         $mtime = is_file($_file_to_check[0]) ? filemtime($_file_to_check[0]) : false;
  42                     }
  43                 } elseif ($_file_to_check[2] == 'string') {
  44                     continue;
  45                 } else {
  46                     $handler = Smarty_Resource::load($tpl->smarty, $_file_to_check[2]);
  47                     if ($handler->checkTimestamps()) {
  48                         $source = Smarty_Template_Source::load($tpl, $tpl->smarty, $_file_to_check[ 0 ]);
  49                         $mtime = $source->getTimeStamp();
  50                     } else {
  51                         continue;
  52                     }
  53                 }
  54                 if (!$mtime || $mtime > $_file_to_check[1]) {
  55                     $is_valid = false;
  56                     break;
  57                 }
  58             }
  59         }
  60         if ($cache) {
  61             // CACHING_LIFETIME_SAVED cache expiry has to be validated here since otherwise we'd define the unifunc
  62             if ($tpl->caching === Smarty::CACHING_LIFETIME_SAVED && $properties['cache_lifetime'] >= 0 &&
  63                 (time() > ($tpl->cached->timestamp + $properties['cache_lifetime']))
  64             ) {
  65                 $is_valid = false;
  66             }
  67             $tpl->cached->cache_lifetime = $properties['cache_lifetime'];
  68             $tpl->cached->valid = $is_valid;
  69             $resource = $tpl->cached;
  70         } else {
  71             $tpl->mustCompile = !$is_valid;
  72             $resource = $tpl->compiled;
  73             $resource->includes = isset($properties['includes']) ? $properties['includes'] : array();
  74         }
  75         if ($is_valid) {
  76             $resource->unifunc = $properties['unifunc'];
  77             $resource->has_nocache_code = $properties['has_nocache_code'];
  78             //            $tpl->compiled->nocache_hash = $properties['nocache_hash'];
  79             $resource->file_dependency = $properties['file_dependency'];
  80             if (isset($properties['tpl_function'])) {
  81                 $tpl->tpl_function = $properties['tpl_function'];
  82             }
  83         }
  84         return $is_valid && !function_exists($properties['unifunc']);
  85     }
  86 }

  10 /**
  11  * Smarty Internal Write File Class
  12  *
  13  * @package    Smarty
  14  * @subpackage PluginsInternal
  15  */
  16 class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_WriteFile
  17 {
  18     /**
  19      * Writes file in a safe way to disk
  20      *
  21      * @param  string $_filepath complete filepath
  22      * @param  string $_contents file content
  23      * @param  Smarty $smarty    smarty instance
  24      *
  25      * @throws SmartyException
  26      * @return boolean true
  27      */
  28     public function writeFile($_filepath, $_contents, Smarty $smarty)
  29     {
  30         $_error_reporting = error_reporting();
  31         error_reporting($_error_reporting & ~E_NOTICE & ~E_WARNING);
  32         $_file_perms = property_exists($smarty, '_file_perms') ? $smarty->_file_perms : 0644;
  33         $_dir_perms = property_exists($smarty, '_dir_perms') ? (isset($smarty->_dir_perms) ? $smarty->_dir_perms : 0777)  : 0771;
  34         if ($_file_perms !== null) {
  35             $old_umask = umask(0);
  36         }
  37 
  38         $_dirpath = dirname($_filepath);
  39         // if subdirs, create dir structure
  40         if ($_dirpath !== '.' && !file_exists($_dirpath)) {
  41             mkdir($_dirpath, $_dir_perms, true);
  42         }
  43 
  44         // write to tmp file, then move to overt file lock race condition
  45         $_tmp_file = $_dirpath . DS . str_replace(array('.', ','), '_', uniqid('wrt', true));
  46         if (!file_put_contents($_tmp_file, $_contents)) {
  47             error_reporting($_error_reporting);
  48             throw new SmartyException("unable to write file {$_tmp_file}");
  49        }
  50 
  51         /*
  52          * Windows' rename() fails if the destination exists,
  53          * Linux' rename() properly handles the overwrite.
  54          * Simply unlink()ing a file might cause other processes
  55          * currently reading that file to fail, but linux' rename()
  56          * seems to be smart enough to handle that for us.
  57          */
  58         if (Smarty::$_IS_WINDOWS) {
  59             // remove original file
  60             if (is_file($_filepath)) {
  61                 @unlink($_filepath);
  62             }
  63             // rename tmp file
  64             $success = @rename($_tmp_file, $_filepath);
  65         } else {
  66             // rename tmp file
  67             $success = @rename($_tmp_file, $_filepath);
  68             if (!$success) {
  69                 // remove original file
  70                 if (is_file($_filepath)) {
  71                     @unlink($_filepath);
  72                 }
  73                 // rename tmp file
  74                 $success = @rename($_tmp_file, $_filepath);
  75             }
  76         }
  77         if (!$success) {
  78             error_reporting($_error_reporting);
  79             throw new SmartyException("unable to write file {$_filepath}");
  80         }
  81         if ($_file_perms !== null) {
  82             // set file permissions
  83             chmod($_filepath, $_file_perms);
  84             umask($old_umask);
  85         }
  86         error_reporting($_error_reporting);
  87 
  88         return true;
  89     }
  90 }

   3  * Smarty Internal Plugin Smarty Template Compiler Base

  11 /**
  12  * Class SmartyTemplateCompiler
  13  *
  14  * @package    Smarty
  15  * @subpackage Compiler
  16  */
  17 class Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler extends Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase
  18 {
  19     /**
  20      * Lexer class name
  21      *
  22      * @var string
  23      */
  24     public $lexer_class;
  25 
  26     /**
  27      * Parser class name
  28      *
  29      * @var string
  30      */
  31     public $parser_class;
  32

  34      * array of vars which can be compiled in local scope
  35      *
  36      * @var array
  37      */

  39 
  40     /**
  41      * array of callbacks called when the normal compile process of template is finished
  42      *
  43      * @var array
  44      */
  45     public $postCompileCallbacks = array();
  46 
  47     /**
  48      * prefix code
  49      *
  50      * @var string
  51      */
  52     public $prefixCompiledCode = '';
  53 
  54     /**
  55      * postfix code
  56      *
  57      * @var string
  58      */
  59     public $postfixCompiledCode = '';
  60 
  61     /**
  62      * Initialize compiler
  63      *
  64      * @param string $lexer_class  class name
  65      * @param string $parser_class class name
  66      * @param Smarty $smarty       global instance
  67      */
  68     public function __construct($lexer_class, $parser_class, Smarty $smarty)
  69     {
  70         parent::__construct($smarty);
  71         // get required plugins
  72         $this->lexer_class = $lexer_class;
  73         $this->parser_class = $parser_class;
  74     }
  75 
  76     /**
  77      * method to compile a Smarty template
  78      *
  79      * @param  mixed $_content template source
  80      * @param bool   $isTemplateSource
  81      *
  82      * @return bool true if compiling succeeded, false if it failed
  83      * @throws \SmartyCompilerException
  84      */
  85     protected function doCompile($_content, $isTemplateSource = false)
  86     {
  87         /* here is where the compiling takes place. Smarty
  88           tags in the templates are replaces with PHP code,
  89           then written to compiled files. */
  90         // init the lexer/parser to compile the template
  91         $this->parser =
  92             new $this->parser_class(new $this->lexer_class(str_replace(array("\r\n", "\r"), "\n", $_content), $this),
  93                                     $this);
  94         if ($isTemplateSource && $this->template->caching) {
  95             $this->parser->insertPhpCode("<?php\n\$_smarty_tpl->compiled->nocache_hash = '{$this->nocache_hash}';\n?>\n");
  96         }
  97         if (function_exists('mb_internal_encoding') && ((int) ini_get('mbstring.func_overload')) & 2) {
  98             $mbEncoding = mb_internal_encoding();
  99             mb_internal_encoding('ASCII');
 100         } else {
 101             $mbEncoding = null;
 102         }
 103 
 104         if ($this->smarty->_parserdebug) {
 105             $this->parser->PrintTrace();
 106             $this->parser->lex->PrintTrace();
 107         }
 108         // get tokens from lexer and parse them
 109         while ($this->parser->lex->yylex()) {
 110             if ($this->smarty->_parserdebug) {
 111                 echo "<pre>Line {$this->parser->lex->line} Parsing  {$this->parser->yyTokenName[$this->parser->lex->token]} Token " .
 112                     htmlentities($this->parser->lex->value) . "</pre>";
 113             }
 114             $this->parser->doParse($this->parser->lex->token, $this->parser->lex->value);
 115         }
 116 
 117         // finish parsing process
 118         $this->parser->doParse(0, 0);
 119         if ($mbEncoding) {
 120             mb_internal_encoding($mbEncoding);
 121         }
 122         // check for unclosed tags
 123         if (count($this->_tag_stack) > 0) {
 124             // get stacked info
 125             list($openTag, $_data) = array_pop($this->_tag_stack);

 128         }
 129         // call post compile callbacks
 130         foreach ($this->postCompileCallbacks as $cb) {
 131             $parameter = $cb;
 132             $parameter[0] = $this;
 133             call_user_func_array($cb[0], $parameter);
 134         }
 135         // return compiled code
 136         return $this->prefixCompiledCode . $this->parser->retvalue . $this->postfixCompiledCode;
 137     }

 139     /**

 141      * - when the callback is called after template compiling the compiler object will be inserted as first parameter
 142      *

 144      * @param array    $parameter optional parameter array

 155         } else {

 157         }

 160     /**
 161      * Remove a post compile callback

 163      * @param string $key callback key
 164      */

 110         $this->template_resource = $template_resource;

 115     /**
 116      * render template
 117      *
 118      * @param  bool $merge_tpl_vars   if true parent template variables merged in to local scope
 119      * @param  bool $no_output_filter if true do not run output filter
 120      * @param  bool $display          true: display, false: fetch null: subtemplate
 121      *
 122      * @throws Exception
 123      * @throws SmartyException
 124      * @return string rendered template output
 125      */
 126     public function render($no_output_filter = true, $display = null)
 127     {
 128         $parentIsTpl = isset($this->parent) && $this->parent->_objType == 2;
 129         if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 130             $this->smarty->_debug->start_template($this, $display);
 131         }
 132         // checks if template exists
 133         if (!$this->source->exists) {
 134             if ($parentIsTpl) {
 135                 $parent_resource = " in '{$this->parent->template_resource}'";
 136             } else {
 137                 $parent_resource = '';
 138             }
 139             throw new SmartyException("Unable to load template {$this->source->type} '{$this->source->name}'{$parent_resource}");
 140         }
 141         // disable caching for evaluated code
 142         if ($this->source->handler->recompiled) {
 143             $this->caching = false;
 144         }
 145         // read from cache or render
 146         $isCacheTpl =

 148         if ($isCacheTpl) {

 153         } elseif ($this->source->handler->uncompiled) {
 154             $this->source->render($this);
 155         } else {
 156             if (!isset($this->compiled)) {
 157                 $this->loadCompiled();
 158             }
 159             $this->compiled->render($this);
 160         }
 161 
 162         // display or fetch
 163         if ($display) {
 164             if ($this->caching && $this->smarty->cache_modified_check) {
 165                 $this->smarty->ext->_cachemodify->cacheModifiedCheck($this->cached, $this,
 166                                                                      isset($content) ? $content : ob_get_clean());
 167             } else {
 168                 if ((!$this->caching || $this->cached->has_nocache_code || $this->source->handler->recompiled) &&
 169                     !$no_output_filter && (isset($this->smarty->autoload_filters['output']) ||
 170                         isset($this->smarty->registered_filters['output']))
 171                 ) {
 172                     echo $this->smarty->ext->_filterHandler->runFilter('output', ob_get_clean(), $this);
 173                 } else {
 174                     ob_end_flush();
 175                     flush();
 176                 }
 177             }
 178             if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 179                 $this->smarty->_debug->end_template($this);
 180                 // debug output
 181                 $this->smarty->_debug->display_debug($this, true);
 182             }
 183             return '';
 184         } else {
 185             if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 186                 $this->smarty->_debug->end_template($this);
 187                 if ($this->smarty->debugging === 2 && $display === false) {
 188                     $this->smarty->_debug->display_debug($this, true);
 189                 }
 190             }
 191             if ($parentIsTpl) {
 192                 if (!empty($this->tpl_function)) {
 193                     $this->parent->tpl_function = array_merge($this->parent->tpl_function, $this->tpl_function);
 194                 }
 195                 foreach ($this->compiled->required_plugins as $code => $tmp1) {
 196                     foreach ($tmp1 as $name => $tmp) {
 197                         foreach ($tmp as $type => $data) {
 198                             $this->parent->compiled->required_plugins[$code][$name][$type] = $data;
 199                         }
 200                     }
 201                 }
 202             }
 203             if (!$no_output_filter &&
 204                 (!$this->caching || $this->cached->has_nocache_code || $this->source->handler->recompiled) &&
 205                 (isset($this->smarty->autoload_filters['output']) || isset($this->smarty->registered_filters['output']))
 206             ) {
 207                 return $this->smarty->ext->_filterHandler->runFilter('output', ob_get_clean(), $this);
 208             }
 209             // return cache content
 210             return null;
 211         }

 285         }

 291     /**
 292      * Handle unknown class methods
 293      *
 294      * @param string $name unknown method-name
 295      * @param array  $args argument array
 296      *
 297      * @return mixed
 298      * @throws SmartyException
 299      */
 300     public function __call($name, $args)
 301     {
 302         // method of Smarty object?
 303         if (method_exists($this->smarty, $name)) {
 304             return call_user_func_array(array($this->smarty, $name), $args);
 305         }
 306         // parent
 307         return parent::__call($name, $args);
 308     }

 310     /**
 311      * set Smarty property in template context
 312      *
 313      * @param string $property_name property name
 314      * @param mixed  $value         value
 315      *
 316      * @throws SmartyException
 317      */
 318     public function __set($property_name, $value)
 319     {
 320         switch ($property_name) {
 321             case 'compiled':
 322             case 'cached':
 323             case 'compiler':
 324                 $this->$property_name = $value;
 325                 return;
 326             default:
 327                 // Smarty property ?
 328                 if (property_exists($this->smarty, $property_name)) {
 329                     $this->smarty->$property_name = $value;
 330                     return;
 331                 }
 332         }
 333         throw new SmartyException("invalid template property '$property_name'.");
 334     }
 335 
 336     /**
 337      * get Smarty property in template context
 338      *
 339      * @param string $property_name property name
 340      *
 341      * @return mixed|Smarty_Template_Cached
 342      * @throws SmartyException
 343      */
 344     public function __get($property_name)
 345     {
 346         switch ($property_name) {
 347             case 'compiled':
 348                 $this->loadCompiled();
 349                 return $this->compiled;
 350 
 351             case 'cached':
 352                 $this->loadCached();
 353                 return $this->cached;
 354 
 355             case 'compiler':
 356                 $this->loadCompiler();
 357                 return $this->compiler;
 358             default:
 359                 // Smarty property ?
 360                 if (property_exists($this->smarty, $property_name)) {
 361                     return $this->smarty->$property_name;
 362                 }
 363         }
 364         throw new SmartyException("template property '$property_name' does not exist.");
 365     }
 366 
 367     /**
 368      * Template data object destructor
 369      */
 370     public function __destruct()
 371     {
 372         if ($this->smarty->cache_locking && isset($this->cached) && $this->cached->is_locked) {
 373             $this->cached->handler->releaseLock($this->smarty, $this->cached);
 374         }
 375     }
 376 }

  41 abstract class Smarty_Internal_TemplateBase extends Smarty_Internal_Data

 117      *
 118      * @param  null|string|\Smarty_Internal_Template $template   the resource handle of the template file or template object
 119      * @param  mixed                                 $cache_id   cache id to be used with this template
 120      * @param  mixed                                 $compile_id compile id to be used with this template
 121      * @param  object                                $parent     next higher level of Smarty variables
 122      *

 124      */

 130     /**
 131      * fetches a rendered Smarty template
 132      *
 133      * @param  string $template   the resource handle of the template file or template object
 134      * @param  mixed  $cache_id   cache id to be used with this template
 135      * @param  mixed  $compile_id compile id to be used with this template
 136      * @param  object $parent     next higher level of Smarty variables
 137      * @param  string $function  function type 0 = fetch,  1 = display, 2 = isCache
 138      *
 139      * @return mixed
 140      * @throws \Exception
 141      * @throws \SmartyException
 142      */
 143     private function _execute($template, $cache_id, $compile_id, $parent, $function)
 144     {
 145         $smarty = $this->_objType == 1 ? $this : $this->smarty;
 146         if ($template === null) {
 147             if ($this->_objType != 2) {
 148                 throw new SmartyException($function . '():Missing \'$template\' parameter');
 149             } else {
 150                 $template = clone $this;
 151             }
 152         } elseif (is_object($template)) {
 153             if (!isset($template->_objType) || $template->_objType != 2) {
 154                 throw new SmartyException($function . '():Template object expected');
 155             } else {
 156                 /* @var Smarty_Internal_Template $template */
 157                 $template = clone $template;
 158             }
 159         } else {
 160             // get template object
 161             /* @var Smarty_Internal_Template $template */
 162             $template = $smarty->createTemplate($template, $cache_id, $compile_id, $parent, false);
 163             if ($this->_objType == 1) {
 164                 // set caching in template object
 165                 $template->caching = $this->caching;
 166             }
 167         }
 168         // fetch template content
 169         $level = ob_get_level();
 170         try {
 171             $_smarty_old_error_level =
 172                 ($this->_objType == 1 && isset($smarty->error_reporting)) ? error_reporting($smarty->error_reporting) :
 173                     null;
 174             if ($function == 2) {
 175                 if ($template->caching) {
 176                     // return cache status of template
 177                     if (!isset($template->cached)) {
 178                         $template->loadCached();
 179                     }
 180                     $result = $template->cached->isCached($template);
 181                     $template->smarty->_cache['isCached'][$template->_getTemplateId()] = $template;
 182                 } else {
 183                     return false;
 184                 }
 185             } else {
 186                 ob_start();
 187                 $template->_mergeVars();
 188                 if (!empty(Smarty::$global_tpl_vars)) {
 189                     $template->tpl_vars = array_merge(Smarty::$global_tpl_vars, $template->tpl_vars);
 190                 }
 191                 $result = $template->render(false, $function);
 192             }
 193             if (isset($_smarty_old_error_level)) {
 194                 error_reporting($_smarty_old_error_level);
 195             }
 196             return $result;
 197         }
 198         catch (Exception $e) {
 199             while (ob_get_level() > $level) {
 200                 ob_end_clean();
 201             }
 202             throw $e;
 203         }
 204     }

  16  * @subpackage Compiler
  17  *
  18  * @property Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler $prefixCompiledCode  = ''
  19  * @property Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler $postfixCompiledCode = ''
  20  * @method Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler registerPostCompileCallback($callback, $parameter = array(), $key = null, $replace = false)
  21  * @method Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler unregisterPostCompileCallback($key)
  22  */
  23 abstract class Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase
  24 {
  25

  58      */

  94     public $templateProperties = array();

 292     /**
 293      * method to compile a Smarty template
 294      *
 295      * @param mixed $_content template source
 296      * @param bool  $isTemplateSource
 297      *
 298      * @return bool true if compiling succeeded, false if it failed
 299      */
 300     abstract protected function doCompile($_content, $isTemplateSource = false);
 301 
 302     /**
 303      * Initialize compiler
 304      *
 305      * @param Smarty $smarty global instance
 306      */
 307     public function __construct(Smarty $smarty)
 308     {
 309         $this->smarty = $smarty;
 310         $this->nocache_hash = str_replace(array('.', ','), '_', uniqid(rand(), true));
 311     }
 312 
 313     /**
 314      * Method to compile a Smarty template
 315      *
 316      * @param  Smarty_Internal_Template                 $template template object to compile
 317      * @param  bool                                     $nocache  true is shall be compiled in nocache mode
 318      * @param null|Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $parent_compiler
 319      *
 320      * @return bool true if compiling succeeded, false if it failed
 321      * @throws \Exception
 322      */
 323     public function compileTemplate(Smarty_Internal_Template $template, $nocache = null,
 324                                     Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $parent_compiler = null)
 325     {
 326         // get code frame of compiled template
 327         $_compiled_code = $template->smarty->ext->_codeFrame->create($template,
 328                                                                      $this->compileTemplateSource($template, $nocache,
 329                                                                                                   $parent_compiler),
 330                                                                      $this->postFilter($this->blockOrFunctionCode) .
 331                                                                      join('', $this->mergedSubTemplatesCode), false,
 332                                                                      $this);
 333         return $_compiled_code;
 334     }
 335 
 336     /**
 337      * Compile template source and run optional post filter
 338      *
 339      * @param \Smarty_Internal_Template             $template
 340      * @param null|bool                             $nocache flag if template must be compiled in nocache mode
 341      * @param \Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $parent_compiler
 342      *
 343      * @return string
 344      * @throws \Exception
 345      */
 346     public function compileTemplateSource(Smarty_Internal_Template $template, $nocache = null,
 347                                           Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $parent_compiler = null)
 348     {
 349         try {
 350             // save template object in compiler class
 351             $this->template = $template;
 352             if (property_exists($this->template->smarty, 'plugin_search_order')) {
 353                 $this->plugin_search_order = $this->template->smarty->plugin_search_order;
 354             }
 355             if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 356                 $this->smarty->_debug->start_compile($this->template);
 357             }
 358             if (isset($this->template->smarty->security_policy)) {
 359                 $this->php_handling = $this->template->smarty->security_policy->php_handling;
 360             } else {
 361                 $this->php_handling = $this->template->smarty->php_handling;
 362             }
 363             $this->parent_compiler = $parent_compiler ? $parent_compiler : $this;
 364             $nocache = isset($nocache) ? $nocache : false;
 365             if (empty($template->compiled->nocache_hash)) {
 366                 $template->compiled->nocache_hash = $this->nocache_hash;
 367             } else {
 368                 $this->nocache_hash = $template->compiled->nocache_hash;
 369             }
 370             // flag for nocache sections
 371             $this->nocache = $nocache;
 372             $this->tag_nocache = false;
 373             // reset has nocache code flag
 374             $this->template->compiled->has_nocache_code = false;
 375             $this->has_variable_string = false;
 376             $this->prefix_code = array();
 377             // add file dependency
 378             $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->file_dependency[ $this->template->source->uid ] =
 379                 array($this->template->source->filepath, $this->template->source->getTimeStamp(),
 380                       $this->template->source->type);
 381             $this->smarty->_current_file = $this->template->source->filepath;
 382             // get template source
 383             if (!empty($this->template->source->components)) {
 384                 // we have array of inheritance templates by extends: resource
 385                 // generate corresponding source code sequence
 386                 $_content =
 387                     Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends::extendsSourceArrayCode($this->template->source->components);
 388             } else {
 389                 // get template source
 390                 $_content = $this->template->source->getContent();
 391             }
 392             $_compiled_code = $this->postFilter($this->doCompile($this->preFilter($_content), true));
 393         }
 394         catch (Exception $e) {
 395             if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 396                 $this->smarty->_debug->end_compile($this->template);
 397             }
 398             $this->_tag_stack = array();
 399             $this->_tag_objects = array();
 400             // free memory
 401             $this->parent_compiler = null;
 402             $this->template = null;
 403             $this->parser = null;
 404             throw $e;
 405         }
 406         if ($this->smarty->debugging) {
 407             $this->smarty->_debug->end_compile($this->template);
 408         }
 409         $this->parent_compiler = null;
 410         $this->template = null;
 411         $this->parser = null;
 412         return $_compiled_code;
 413     }
 414 
 415     /**
 416      * Optionally process compiled code by post filter
 417      *
 418      * @param string $code compiled code
 419      *
 420      * @return string
 421      * @throws \SmartyException
 422      */
 423     public function postFilter($code)
 424     {
 425         // run post filter if on code
 426         if (!empty($code) &&
 427             (isset($this->smarty->autoload_filters[ 'post' ]) || isset($this->smarty->registered_filters[ 'post' ]))
 428         ) {
 429             return $this->smarty->ext->_filterHandler->runFilter('post', $code, $this->template);
 430         } else {
 431             return $code;
 432         }
 433     }
 434 
 435     /**
 436      * Run optional prefilter
 437      *
 438      * @param string $_content template source
 439      *
 440      * @return string
 441      * @throws \SmartyException
 442      */
 443     public function preFilter($_content)
 444     {
 445         // run pre filter if required
 446         if ($_content != '' &&
 447             ((isset($this->smarty->autoload_filters[ 'pre' ]) || isset($this->smarty->registered_filters[ 'pre' ])))
 448         ) {
 449             return $this->smarty->ext->_filterHandler->runFilter('pre', $_content, $this->template);
 450         } else {
 451             return $_content;
 452         }
 453     }
 454 
 455     /**
 456      * Compile Tag
 457      * This is a call back from the lexer/parser
 458      *
 459      * Save current prefix code
 460      * Compile tag
 461      * Merge tag prefix code with saved one
 462      * (required nested tags in attributes)
 463      *
 464      * @param  string $tag       tag name
 465      * @param  array  $args      array with tag attributes
 466      * @param  array  $parameter array with compilation parameter
 467      *
 468      * @throws SmartyCompilerException
 469      * @throws SmartyException
 470      * @return string compiled code
 471      */
 472     public function compileTag($tag, $args, $parameter = array())
 473     {
 474         $this->prefixCodeStack[] = $this->prefix_code;
 475         $this->prefix_code = array();
 476         $result = $this->compileTag2($tag, $args, $parameter);
 477         $this->prefix_code = array_merge($this->prefix_code, array_pop($this->prefixCodeStack));
 478         return $result;
 479     }
 480 
 481     /**
 482      * Compile Tag
 483      *
 484      * @param  string $tag       tag name
 485      * @param  array  $args      array with tag attributes
 486      * @param  array  $parameter array with compilation parameter
 487      *
 488      * @throws SmartyCompilerException
 489      * @throws SmartyException
 490      * @return string compiled code
 491      */
 492     private function compileTag2($tag, $args, $parameter)
 493     {
 494         $plugin_type = '';
 495         // $args contains the attributes parsed and compiled by the lexer/parser
 496         // assume that tag does compile into code, but creates no HTML output
 497         $this->has_code = true;
 498         $this->has_output = false;
 499         // log tag/attributes
 500         if (isset($this->smarty->_cache[ 'get_used_tags' ])) {
 501             $this->template->_cache[ 'used_tags' ][] = array($tag, $args);
 502         }
 503         // check nocache option flag
 504         if (in_array("'nocache'", $args) || in_array(array('nocache' => 'true'), $args) ||
 505             in_array(array('nocache' => '"true"'), $args) || in_array(array('nocache' => "'true'"), $args)
 506         ) {
 507             $this->tag_nocache = true;
 508         }
 509         // compile the smarty tag (required compile classes to compile the tag are auto loaded)
 510         if (($_output = $this->callTagCompiler($tag, $args, $parameter)) === false) {
 511             if (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->tpl_function[ $tag ])) {
 512                 // template defined by {template} tag
 513                 $args[ '_attr' ][ 'name' ] = "'" . $tag . "'";
 514                 $_output = $this->callTagCompiler('call', $args, $parameter);
 515             }
 516         }
 517         if ($_output !== false) {
 518             if ($_output !== true) {
 519                 // did we get compiled code
 520                 if ($this->has_code) {
 521                     // Does it create output?
 522                     if ($this->has_output) {
 523                         $_output .= "\n";
 524                     }
 525                     // return compiled code
 526                     return $_output;
 527                 }
 528             }
 529             // tag did not produce compiled code
 530             return null;
 531         } else {
 532             // map_named attributes
 533             if (isset($args[ '_attr' ])) {
 534                 foreach ($args[ '_attr' ] as $key => $attribute) {
 535                     if (is_array($attribute)) {
 536                         $args = array_merge($args, $attribute);
 537                     }
 538                 }
 539             }
 540             // not an internal compiler tag
 541             if (strlen($tag) < 6 || substr($tag, - 5) != 'close') {
 542                 // check if tag is a registered object
 543                 if (isset($this->smarty->registered_objects[ $tag ]) && isset($parameter[ 'object_method' ])) {
 544                     $method = $parameter[ 'object_method' ];
 545                     if (!in_array($method, $this->smarty->registered_objects[ $tag ][ 3 ]) &&
 546                         (empty($this->smarty->registered_objects[ $tag ][ 1 ]) ||
 547                             in_array($method, $this->smarty->registered_objects[ $tag ][ 1 ]))
 548                     ) {
 549                         return $this->callTagCompiler('private_object_function', $args, $parameter, $tag, $method);
 550                     } elseif (in_array($method, $this->smarty->registered_objects[ $tag ][ 3 ])) {
 551                         return $this->callTagCompiler('private_object_block_function', $args, $parameter, $tag,
 552                                                       $method);
 553                     } else {
 554                         // throw exception
 555                         $this->trigger_template_error('not allowed method "' . $method . '" in registered object "' .
 556                                                       $tag . '"', null, true);
 557                     }
 558                 }
 559                 // check if tag is registered
 560                 foreach (array(Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER, Smarty::PLUGIN_FUNCTION, Smarty::PLUGIN_BLOCK) as $plugin_type)
 561                 {
 562                     if (isset($this->smarty->registered_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ])) {
 563                         // if compiler function plugin call it now
 564                         if ($plugin_type == Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER) {
 565                             $new_args = array();
 566                             foreach ($args as $key => $mixed) {
 567                                 if (is_array($mixed)) {
 568                                     $new_args = array_merge($new_args, $mixed);
 569                                 } else {
 570                                     $new_args[ $key ] = $mixed;
 571                                 }
 572                             }
 573                             if (!$this->smarty->registered_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ][ 1 ]) {
 574                                 $this->tag_nocache = true;
 575                             }
 576                             $function = $this->smarty->registered_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ][ 0 ];
 577                             if (!is_array($function)) {
 578                                 return $function($new_args, $this);
 579                             } elseif (is_object($function[ 0 ])) {
 580                                 return $this->smarty->registered_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ][ 0 ][ 0 ]->{$function[ 1 ]}($new_args,
 581                                                                                                                              $this);
 582                             } else {
 583                                 return call_user_func_array($function, array($new_args, $this));
 584                             }
 585                         }
 586                         // compile registered function or block function
 587                         if ($plugin_type == Smarty::PLUGIN_FUNCTION || $plugin_type == Smarty::PLUGIN_BLOCK) {
 588                             return $this->callTagCompiler('private_registered_' . $plugin_type, $args, $parameter,
 589                                                           $tag);
 590                         }
 591                     }
 592                 }
 593                 // check plugins from plugins folder
 594                 foreach ($this->plugin_search_order as $plugin_type) {
 595                     if ($plugin_type == Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER &&
 596                         $this->smarty->loadPlugin('smarty_compiler_' . $tag) &&
 597                         (!isset($this->smarty->security_policy) ||
 598                             $this->smarty->security_policy->isTrustedTag($tag, $this))
 599                     ) {
 600                         $plugin = 'smarty_compiler_' . $tag;
 601                         if (is_callable($plugin)) {
 602                             // convert arguments format for old compiler plugins
 603                             $new_args = array();
 604                             foreach ($args as $key => $mixed) {
 605                                 if (is_array($mixed)) {
 606                                     $new_args = array_merge($new_args, $mixed);
 607                                 } else {
 608                                     $new_args[ $key ] = $mixed;
 609                                 }
 610                             }
 611 
 612                             return $plugin($new_args, $this->smarty);
 613                         }
 614                         if (class_exists($plugin, false)) {
 615                             $plugin_object = new $plugin;
 616                             if (method_exists($plugin_object, 'compile')) {
 617                                 return $plugin_object->compile($args, $this);
 618                             }
 619                         }
 620                         throw new SmartyException("Plugin \"{$tag}\" not callable");
 621                     } else {
 622                         if ($function = $this->getPlugin($tag, $plugin_type)) {
 623                             if (!isset($this->smarty->security_policy) ||
 624                                 $this->smarty->security_policy->isTrustedTag($tag, $this)
 625                             ) {
 626                                 return $this->callTagCompiler('private_' . $plugin_type . '_plugin', $args, $parameter,
 627                                                               $tag, $function);
 628                             }
 629                         }
 630                     }
 631                 }
 632                 if (is_callable($this->smarty->default_plugin_handler_func)) {
 633                     $found = false;
 634                     // look for already resolved tags
 635                     foreach ($this->plugin_search_order as $plugin_type) {
 636                         if (isset($this->default_handler_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ])) {
 637                             $found = true;
 638                             break;
 639                         }
 640                     }
 641                     if (!$found) {
 642                         // call default handler
 643                         foreach ($this->plugin_search_order as $plugin_type) {
 644                             if ($this->getPluginFromDefaultHandler($tag, $plugin_type)) {
 645                                 $found = true;
 646                                 break;
 647                             }
 648                         }
 649                     }
 650                     if ($found) {
 651                         // if compiler function plugin call it now
 652                         if ($plugin_type == Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER) {
 653                             $new_args = array();
 654                             foreach ($args as $mixed) {
 655                                 $new_args = array_merge($new_args, $mixed);
 656                             }
 657                             $function = $this->default_handler_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ][ 0 ];
 658                             if (!is_array($function)) {
 659                                 return $function($new_args, $this);
 660                             } elseif (is_object($function[ 0 ])) {
 661                                 return $this->default_handler_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ][ 0 ][ 0 ]->$function[ 1 ]($new_args,
 662                                                                                                                         $this);
 663                             } else {
 664                                 return call_user_func_array($function, array($new_args, $this));
 665                             }
 666                         } else {
 667                             return $this->callTagCompiler('private_registered_' . $plugin_type, $args, $parameter,
 668                                                           $tag);
 669                         }
 670                     }
 671                 }
 672             } else {
 673                 // compile closing tag of block function
 674                 $base_tag = substr($tag, 0, - 5);
 675                 // check if closing tag is a registered object
 676                 if (isset($this->smarty->registered_objects[ $base_tag ]) && isset($parameter[ 'object_method' ])) {
 677                     $method = $parameter[ 'object_method' ];
 678                     if (in_array($method, $this->smarty->registered_objects[ $base_tag ][ 3 ])) {
 679                         return $this->callTagCompiler('private_object_block_function', $args, $parameter, $tag,
 680                                                       $method);
 681                     } else {
 682                         // throw exception
 683                         $this->trigger_template_error('not allowed closing tag method "' . $method .
 684                                                       '" in registered object "' . $base_tag . '"', null, true);
 685                     }
 686                 }
 687                 // registered block tag ?
 688                 if (isset($this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_BLOCK ][ $base_tag ]) ||
 689                     isset($this->default_handler_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_BLOCK ][ $base_tag ])
 690                 ) {
 691                     return $this->callTagCompiler('private_registered_block', $args, $parameter, $tag);
 692                 }
 693                 // registered function tag ?
 694                 if (isset($this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_FUNCTION ][ $tag ])) {
 695                     return $this->callTagCompiler('private_registered_function', $args, $parameter, $tag);
 696                 }
 697                 // block plugin?
 698                 if ($function = $this->getPlugin($base_tag, Smarty::PLUGIN_BLOCK)) {
 699                     return $this->callTagCompiler('private_block_plugin', $args, $parameter, $tag, $function);
 700                 }
 701                 // function plugin?
 702                 if ($function = $this->getPlugin($tag, Smarty::PLUGIN_FUNCTION)) {
 703                     if (!isset($this->smarty->security_policy) ||
 704                         $this->smarty->security_policy->isTrustedTag($tag, $this)
 705                     ) {
 706                         return $this->callTagCompiler('private_function_plugin', $args, $parameter, $tag, $function);
 707                     }
 708                 }
 709                 // registered compiler plugin ?
 710                 if (isset($this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER ][ $tag ])) {
 711                     // if compiler function plugin call it now
 712                     $args = array();
 713                     if (!$this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER ][ $tag ][ 1 ]) {
 714                         $this->tag_nocache = true;
 715                     }
 716                     $function = $this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER ][ $tag ][ 0 ];
 717                     if (!is_array($function)) {
 718                         return $function($args, $this);
 719                     } elseif (is_object($function[ 0 ])) {
 720                         return $this->smarty->registered_plugins[ Smarty::PLUGIN_COMPILER ][ $tag ][ 0 ][ 0 ]->$function[ 1 ]($args,
 721                                                                                                                               $this);
 722                     } else {
 723                         return call_user_func_array($function, array($args, $this));
 724                     }
 725                 }
 726                 if ($this->smarty->loadPlugin('smarty_compiler_' . $tag)) {
 727                     $plugin = 'smarty_compiler_' . $tag;
 728                     if (is_callable($plugin)) {
 729                         return $plugin($args, $this->smarty);
 730                     }
 731                     if (class_exists($plugin, false)) {
 732                         $plugin_object = new $plugin;
 733                         if (method_exists($plugin_object, 'compile')) {
 734                             return $plugin_object->compile($args, $this);
 735                         }
 736                     }
 737                     throw new SmartyException("Plugin \"{$tag}\" not callable");
 738                 }
 739             }
 740             $this->trigger_template_error("unknown tag \"" . $tag . "\"", null, true);
 741         }

 776     /**
 777      * This method is called from parser to process a text content section
 778      * - remove text from inheritance child templates as they may generate output
 779      * - strip text if strip is enabled
 780      *
 781      * @param string $text
 782      *
 783      * @return null|\Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Text
 784      */
 785     public function processText($text)
 786     {
 787         if ((string) $text != '') {
 788             $store = array();
 789             $_store = 0;
 790             $_offset = 0;
 791             if ($this->parser->strip) {
 792                 if (strpos($text, '<') !== false) {
 793                     // capture html elements not to be messed with
 794                     $_offset = 0;
 795                     if (preg_match_all('#(<script[^>]*>.*?</script[^>]*>)|(<textarea[^>]*>.*?</textarea[^>]*>)|(<pre[^>]*>.*?</pre[^>]*>)#is',
 796                                        $text, $matches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE | PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
 797                         foreach ($matches as $match) {
 798                             $store[] = $match[ 0 ][ 0 ];
 799                             $_length = strlen($match[ 0 ][ 0 ]);
 800                             $replace = '@!@SMARTY:' . $_store . ':SMARTY@!@';
 801                             $text = substr_replace($text, $replace, $match[ 0 ][ 1 ] - $_offset, $_length);
 802 
 803                             $_offset += $_length - strlen($replace);
 804                             $_store ++;
 805                         }
 806                     }
 807 
 808                     $expressions = array(// replace multiple spaces between tags by a single space
 809                                          // can't remove them entirely, becaue that might break poorly implemented CSS display:inline-block elements
 810                                          '#(:SMARTY@!@|>)\s+(?=@!@SMARTY:|<)#s'                                    => '\1 \2',
 811                                          // remove spaces between attributes (but not in attribute values!)
 812                                          '#(([a-z0-9]\s*=\s*("[^"]*?")|(\'[^\']*?\'))|<[a-z0-9_]+)\s+([a-z/>])#is' => '\1 \5',
 813                                          '#^\s+<#Ss'                                                               => '<',
 814                                          '#>\s+$#Ss'                                                               => '>',
 815                                          $this->stripRegEx                                                         => '');
 816 
 817                     $text = preg_replace(array_keys($expressions), array_values($expressions), $text);
 818                     $_offset = 0;
 819                     if (preg_match_all('#@!@SMARTY:([0-9]+):SMARTY@!@#is', $text, $matches,
 820                                        PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE | PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
 821                         foreach ($matches as $match) {
 822                             $_length = strlen($match[ 0 ][ 0 ]);
 823                             $replace = $store[ $match[ 1 ][ 0 ] ];
 824                             $text = substr_replace($text, $replace, $match[ 0 ][ 1 ] + $_offset, $_length);
 825 
 826                             $_offset += strlen($replace) - $_length;
 827                             $_store ++;
 828                         }
 829                     }
 830                 } else {
 831                     $text = preg_replace($this->stripRegEx, '', $text);
 832                 }
 833             }
 834             return new Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Text($text);
 835         }
 836         return null;
 837     }

 839     /**
 840      * lazy loads internal compile plugin for tag and calls the compile method
 841      * compile objects cached for reuse.
 842      * class name format:  Smarty_Internal_Compile_TagName
 843      * plugin filename format: Smarty_Internal_TagName.php
 844      *
 845      * @param  string $tag    tag name
 846      * @param  array  $args   list of tag attributes
 847      * @param  mixed  $param1 optional parameter
 848      * @param  mixed  $param2 optional parameter
 849      * @param  mixed  $param3 optional parameter
 850      *
 851      * @return string compiled code
 852      */
 853     public function callTagCompiler($tag, $args, $param1 = null, $param2 = null, $param3 = null)
 854     {
 855         // re-use object if already exists
 856         if (!isset($this->_tag_objects[ $tag ])) {
 857             // lazy load internal compiler plugin
 858             $_tag = explode('_', $tag);
 859             $_tag = array_map('ucfirst', $_tag);
 860             $class_name = 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_' . implode('_', $_tag);
 861             if (class_exists($class_name) &&
 862                 (!isset($this->smarty->security_policy) || $this->smarty->security_policy->isTrustedTag($tag, $this))
 863             ) {
 864                 $this->_tag_objects[ $tag ] = new $class_name;
 865             } else {
 866                 $this->_tag_objects[ $tag ] = false;
 867                 return false;
 868             }
 869         }
 870         // compile this tag
 871         return $this->_tag_objects[ $tag ] === false ? false :
 872             $this->_tag_objects[ $tag ]->compile($args, $this, $param1, $param2, $param3);
 873     }

 875     /**
 876      * Check for plugins and return function name
 877      *
 878      * @param         $plugin_name
 879      * @param  string $plugin_type type of plugin
 880      *
 881      * @return string call name of function
 882      */
 883     public function getPlugin($plugin_name, $plugin_type)
 884     {
 885         $function = null;
 886         if ($this->template->caching && ($this->nocache || $this->tag_nocache)) {
 887             if (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ])) {
 888                 $function =
 889                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ];
 890             } elseif (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ])) {
 891                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ] =
 892                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ];
 893                 $function =
 894                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ];
 895             }
 896         } else {
 897             if (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ])) {
 898                 $function =
 899                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ];
 900             } elseif (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ])) {
 901                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ] =
 902                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ];
 903                 $function =
 904                     $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ];
 905             }
 906         }
 907         if (isset($function)) {
 908             if ($plugin_type == 'modifier') {
 909                 $this->modifier_plugins[ $plugin_name ] = true;
 910             }
 911 
 912             return $function;
 913         }
 914         // loop through plugin dirs and find the plugin
 915         $function = 'smarty_' . $plugin_type . '_' . $plugin_name;
 916         $file = $this->smarty->loadPlugin($function, false);
 917 
 918         if (is_string($file)) {
 919             if ($this->template->caching && ($this->nocache || $this->tag_nocache)) {
 920                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'file' ] =
 921                     $file;
 922                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ] =
 923                     $function;
 924             } else {
 925                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'file' ] =
 926                     $file;
 927                 $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ] =
 928                     $function;
 929             }
 930             if ($plugin_type == 'modifier') {
 931                 $this->modifier_plugins[ $plugin_name ] = true;
 932             }
 933 
 934             return $function;
 935         }
 936         if (is_callable($function)) {
 937             // plugin function is defined in the script
 938             return $function;
 939         }
 940 
 941         return false;
 942     }
