 944     /**
 945      * Check for plugins by default plugin handler
 946      *
 947      * @param  string $tag         name of tag
 948      * @param  string $plugin_type type of plugin
 949      *
 950      * @return boolean true if found
 951      */
 952     public function getPluginFromDefaultHandler($tag, $plugin_type)
 953     {
 954         $callback = null;
 955         $script = null;
 956         $cacheable = true;
 957         $result = call_user_func_array($this->smarty->default_plugin_handler_func,
 958                                        array($tag, $plugin_type, $this->template, &$callback, &$script, &$cacheable));
 959         if ($result) {
 960             $this->tag_nocache = $this->tag_nocache || !$cacheable;
 961             if ($script !== null) {
 962                 if (is_file($script)) {
 963                     if ($this->template->caching && ($this->nocache || $this->tag_nocache)) {
 964                         $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $tag ][ $plugin_type ][ 'file' ] =
 965                             $script;
 966                         $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $tag ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ] =
 967                             $callback;
 968                     } else {
 969                         $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $tag ][ $plugin_type ][ 'file' ] =
 970                             $script;
 971                         $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $tag ][ $plugin_type ][ 'function' ] =
 972                             $callback;
 973                     }
 974                     require_once $script;
 975                 } else {
 976                     $this->trigger_template_error("Default plugin handler: Returned script file \"{$script}\" for \"{$tag}\" not found");
 977                 }
 978             }
 979             if (!is_string($callback) &&
 980                 !(is_array($callback) && is_string($callback[ 0 ]) && is_string($callback[ 1 ]))
 981             ) {
 982                 $this->trigger_template_error("Default plugin handler: Returned callback for \"{$tag}\" must be a static function name or array of class and function name");
 983             }
 984             if (is_callable($callback)) {
 985                 $this->default_handler_plugins[ $plugin_type ][ $tag ] = array($callback, true, array());
 986 
 987                 return true;
 988             } else {
 989                 $this->trigger_template_error("Default plugin handler: Returned callback for \"{$tag}\" not callable");
 990             }
 991         }
 992 
 993         return false;
 994     }

 996     /**
 997      * Append code segments and remove unneeded ?> <?php transitions
 998      *
 999      * @param string $left
1000      * @param string $right
1001      *
1002      * @return string
1003      */
1004     public function appendCode($left, $right)
1005     {
1006         if (preg_match('/\s*\?>\s*$/', $left) && preg_match('/^\s*<\?php\s+/', $right)) {
1007             $left = preg_replace('/\s*\?>\s*$/', "\n", $left);
1008             $left .= preg_replace('/^\s*<\?php\s+/', '', $right);
1009         } else {
1010             $left .= $right;
1011         }
1012         return $left;
1013     }

1015     /**
1016      * Inject inline code for nocache template sections
1017      * This method gets the content of each template element from the parser.
1018      * If the content is compiled code and it should be not cached the code is injected
1019      * into the rendered output.
1020      *
1021      * @param  string  $content content of template element
1022      * @param  boolean $is_code true if content is compiled code
1023      *
1024      * @return string  content
1025      */
1026     public function processNocacheCode($content, $is_code)
1027     {
1028         // If the template is not evaluated and we have a nocache section and or a nocache tag
1029         if ($is_code && !empty($content)) {
1030             // generate replacement code
1031             if ((!($this->template->source->handler->recompiled) || $this->forceNocache) && $this->template->caching &&
1032                 !$this->suppressNocacheProcessing && ($this->nocache || $this->tag_nocache)
1033             ) {
1034                 $this->template->compiled->has_nocache_code = true;
1035                 $_output = addcslashes($content, '\'\\');
1036                 $_output = str_replace("^#^", "'", $_output);
1037                 $_output = "<?php echo '/*%%SmartyNocache:{$this->nocache_hash}%%*/" . $_output .
1038                     "/*/%%SmartyNocache:{$this->nocache_hash}%%*/';?>\n";
1039                 // make sure we include modifier plugins for nocache code
1040                 foreach ($this->modifier_plugins as $plugin_name => $dummy) {
1041                     if (isset($this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ 'modifier' ])) {
1042                         $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'nocache' ][ $plugin_name ][ 'modifier' ] =
1043                             $this->parent_compiler->template->compiled->required_plugins[ 'compiled' ][ $plugin_name ][ 'modifier' ];
1044                     }
1045                 }
1046             } else {
1047                 $_output = $content;
1048             }
1049         } else {
1050             $_output = $content;
1051         }
1052         $this->modifier_plugins = array();
1053         $this->suppressNocacheProcessing = false;
1054         $this->tag_nocache = false;
1055 
1056         return $_output;
1057     }

1102     /**
1103      * display compiler error messages without dying
1104      * If parameter $args is empty it is a parser detected syntax error.
1105      * In this case the parser is called to obtain information about expected tokens.
1106      * If parameter $args contains a string this is used as error message
1107      *
1108      * @param  string   $args    individual error message or null
1109      * @param  string   $line    line-number
1110      * @param null|bool $tagline if true the line number of last tag
1111      *
1112      * @throws \SmartyCompilerException when an unexpected token is found
1113      */
1114     public function trigger_template_error($args = null, $line = null, $tagline = null)
1115     {
1116         $lex = $this->parser->lex;
1117         if ($tagline === true) {
1118             // get line number of Tag
1119             $line = $lex->taglineno;
1120         } elseif (!isset($line)) {
1121             // get template source line which has error
1122             $line = $lex->line;
1123         } else {
1124             $line = (int) $line;
1125         }
1126 
1127         if (in_array($this->template->source->type, array('eval', 'string'))) {
1128             $templateName = $this->template->source->type . ':' . trim(preg_replace('![\t\r\n]+!', ' ',
1129                                                                                     strlen($lex->data) > 40 ?
1130                                                                                         substr($lex->data, 0, 40) .
1131                                                                                         '...' : $lex->data));
1132         } else {
1133             $templateName = $this->template->source->type . ':' . $this->template->source->filepath;
1134         }
1135 
1136         //        $line += $this->trace_line_offset;
1137         $match = preg_split("/\n/", $lex->data);
1138         $error_text =
1139             'Syntax error in template "' . (empty($this->trace_filepath) ? $templateName : $this->trace_filepath) .
1140             '"  on line ' . ($line + $this->trace_line_offset) . ' "' .
1141             trim(preg_replace('![\t\r\n]+!', ' ', $match[ $line - 1 ])) . '" ';
1142         if (isset($args)) {
1143             // individual error message
1144             $error_text .= $args;
1145         } else {
1146             $expect = array();
1147             // expected token from parser
1148             $error_text .= ' - Unexpected "' . $lex->value . '"';
1149             if (count($this->parser->yy_get_expected_tokens($this->parser->yymajor)) <= 4) {
1150                 foreach ($this->parser->yy_get_expected_tokens($this->parser->yymajor) as $token) {
1151                     $exp_token = $this->parser->yyTokenName[ $token ];
1152                     if (isset($lex->smarty_token_names[ $exp_token ])) {
1153                         // token type from lexer
1154                         $expect[] = '"' . $lex->smarty_token_names[ $exp_token ] . '"';
1155                     } else {
1156                         // otherwise internal token name
1157                         $expect[] = $this->parser->yyTokenName[ $token ];
1158                     }
1159                 }
1160                 $error_text .= ', expected one of: ' . implode(' , ', $expect);
1161             }
1162         }
1163         $e = new SmartyCompilerException($error_text);
1164         $e->line = $line;
1165         $e->source = trim(preg_replace('![\t\r\n]+!', ' ', $match[ $line - 1 ]));
1166         $e->desc = $args;
1167         $e->template = $this->template->source->filepath;
1168         throw $e;
1169     }
1170 }

 197     /**
 198      * constructor
 199      *
 200      * @param   string                             $data template source
 201      * @param Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler
 202      */
 203     function __construct($data, Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase $compiler)
 204     {
 205         $this->data = $data;
 206         $this->counter = 0;
 207         if (preg_match('~^\xEF\xBB\xBF~i', $this->data, $match)) {
 208             $this->counter += strlen($match[ 0 ]);
 209         }
 210         $this->line = 1;
 211         $this->smarty = $compiler->smarty;
 212         $this->compiler = $compiler;
 213         $this->ldel = preg_quote($this->smarty->left_delimiter, '~');
 214         $this->ldel_length = strlen($this->smarty->left_delimiter);
 215         $this->rdel = preg_quote($this->smarty->right_delimiter, '~');
 216         $this->rdel_length = strlen($this->smarty->right_delimiter);
 217         $this->smarty_token_names[ 'LDEL' ] = $this->smarty->left_delimiter;
 218         $this->smarty_token_names[ 'RDEL' ] = $this->smarty->right_delimiter;
 219     }

 231     {

 233             strpos(" \n\t\r", $this->value[ $this->ldel_length ]) !== false : false;
 234     }

 245     public function yypushstate($state)
 246     {
 247         if ($this->yyTraceFILE) {
 248             fprintf($this->yyTraceFILE, "%sState push %s\n", $this->yyTracePrompt,
 249                     isset($this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ]) ? $this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ] :
 250                         $this->_yy_state);
 251         }
 252         array_push($this->_yy_stack, $this->_yy_state);
 253         $this->_yy_state = $state;
 254         if ($this->yyTraceFILE) {
 255             fprintf($this->yyTraceFILE, "%snew State %s\n", $this->yyTracePrompt,
 256                     isset($this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ]) ? $this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ] :
 257                         $this->_yy_state);
 258         }
 259     }

 261     public function yypopstate()

 265                     isset($this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ]) ? $this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ] :
 266                         $this->_yy_state);
 267         }
 268         $this->_yy_state = array_pop($this->_yy_stack);
 269         if ($this->yyTraceFILE) {
 270             fprintf($this->yyTraceFILE, "%snew State %s\n", $this->yyTracePrompt,
 271                     isset($this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ]) ? $this->state_name[ $this->_yy_state ] :
 272                         $this->_yy_state);
 273         }

 286     public function yylex1()
 287     {
 288         if (!isset($this->yy_global_pattern1)) {
 289             $this->yy_global_pattern1 =
 290                 "/\G([{][}])|\G(" . $this->ldel . "[*])|\G((" . $this->ldel . "\\s*php(.*?)" . $this->rdel . ")|(" .
 291                 $this->ldel . "\\s*[\/]php" . $this->rdel . "))|\G(" . $this->ldel . "\\s*literal\\s*" . $this->rdel .
 292                 ")|\G(" . $this->ldel . "\\s*)|\G(\\s*" . $this->rdel .
 293                 ")|\G((<[?]((php\\s+|=)|\\s+))|(<[%])|(<[?]xml\\s+)|(<script\\s+language\\s*=\\s*[\"']?\\s*php\\s*[\"']?\\s*>)|([?][>])|([%][>]))|\G([\S\s])/isS";
 294         }
 295         if ($this->counter >= strlen($this->data)) {
 296             return false; // end of input
 297         }
 298 
 299         do {
 300             if (preg_match($this->yy_global_pattern1, $this->data, $yymatches, null, $this->counter)) {
 301                 $yysubmatches = $yymatches;
 302                 if (strlen($yysubmatches[ 0 ]) < 200) {
 303                     $yymatches = preg_grep("/(.|\s)+/", $yysubmatches);
 304                 } else {
 305                     $yymatches = array_filter($yymatches, 'strlen');
 306                 }
 307                 if (empty($yymatches)) {
 308                     throw new Exception('Error: lexing failed because a rule matched' . ' an empty string.  Input "' .
 309                                         substr($this->data, $this->counter, 5) . '... state TEXT');
 310                 }
 311                 next($yymatches); // skip global match
 312                 $this->token = key($yymatches); // token number
 313                 $this->value = current($yymatches); // token value
 314                 $r = $this->{'yy_r1_' . $this->token}();
 315                 if ($r === null) {
 316                     $this->counter += strlen($this->value);
 317                     $this->line += substr_count($this->value, "\n");
 318                     // accept this token
 319                     return true;
 320                 } elseif ($r === true) {
 321                     // we have changed state
 322                     // process this token in the new state
 323                     return $this->yylex();
 324                 } elseif ($r === false) {
 325                     $this->counter += strlen($this->value);
 326                     $this->line += substr_count($this->value, "\n");
 327                     if ($this->counter >= strlen($this->data)) {
 328                         return false; // end of input
 329                     }
 330                     // skip this token
 331                     continue;
 332                 }
 333             } else {
 334                 throw new Exception('Unexpected input at line' . $this->line . ': ' . $this->data[ $this->counter ]);
 335             }
 336             break;
 337         } while (true);
 338     } // end function

 348     function yy_r1_2()
 349     {
 350 
 351         preg_match("~[*]{$this->rdel}~", $this->data, $match, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $this->counter);
 352         if (isset($match[ 0 ][ 1 ])) {
 353             $to = $match[ 0 ][ 1 ] + strlen($match[ 0 ][ 0 ]);
 354         } else {
 355             $this->compiler->trigger_template_error("missing or misspelled comment closing tag '*{$this->smarty->right_delimiter}'");
 356         }
 357         $this->value = substr($this->data, $this->counter, $to - $this->counter);
 358         return false;
 359     }

 137     /**
 138      * Load Resource Handler
 139      *
 140      * @param  Smarty $smarty smarty object
 141      * @param  string $type   name of the resource
 142      *
 143      * @throws SmartyException
 144      * @return Smarty_Resource Resource Handler
 145      */
 146     public static function load(Smarty $smarty, $type)
 147     {
 148         // try smarty's cache
 149         if (isset($smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type])) {
 150             return $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type];
 151         }
 152 
 153         // try registered resource
 154         if (isset($smarty->registered_resources[$type])) {
 155             return $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type] =
 156                 $smarty->registered_resources[$type] instanceof Smarty_Resource ? $smarty->registered_resources[$type] :
 157                     new Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered();
 158         }
 159 
 160         // try sysplugins dir
 161         if (isset(self::$sysplugins[$type])) {
 162             $_resource_class = 'Smarty_Internal_Resource_' . ucfirst($type);
 163             return $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type] = new $_resource_class();
 164         }
 165 
 166         // try plugins dir
 167         $_resource_class = 'Smarty_Resource_' . ucfirst($type);
 168         if ($smarty->loadPlugin($_resource_class)) {
 169             if (class_exists($_resource_class, false)) {
 170                 return $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type] = new $_resource_class();
 171             } else {
 172                 $smarty->registerResource($type,
 173                                           array("smarty_resource_{$type}_source", "smarty_resource_{$type}_timestamp",
 174                                                 "smarty_resource_{$type}_secure", "smarty_resource_{$type}_trusted"));
 175                 // give it another try, now that the resource is registered properly
 176                 return self::load($smarty, $type);
 177             }
 178         }
 179 
 180         // try streams
 181         $_known_stream = stream_get_wrappers();
 182         if (in_array($type, $_known_stream)) {
 183             // is known stream
 184             if (is_object($smarty->security_policy)) {
 185                 $smarty->security_policy->isTrustedStream($type);
 186             }
 187             return $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type] = new Smarty_Internal_Resource_Stream();
 188         }
 189 
 190         // TODO: try default_(template|config)_handler
 191 
 192         // give up
 193         throw new SmartyException("Unknown resource type '{$type}'");
 194     }

 196     /**
 197      * extract resource_type and resource_name from template_resource and config_resource
 198      * @note "C:/foo.tpl" was forced to file resource up till Smarty 3.1.3 (including).
 199      *
 200      * @param  string $resource_name    template_resource or config_resource to parse
 201      * @param  string $default_resource the default resource_type defined in $smarty
 202      *
 203      * @return array with parsed resource name and type
 204      */
 205     public static function parseResourceName($resource_name, $default_resource)
 206     {
 207         if (preg_match('/^([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{2,})[:]/', $resource_name, $match)) {
 208             $type = $match[1];
 209             $name = substr($resource_name, strlen($match[0]));
 210         } else {
 211             // no resource given, use default
 212             // or single character before the colon is not a resource type, but part of the filepath
 213             $type = $default_resource;
 214             $name = $resource_name;
 215         }
 216         return array($name, $type);
 217     }

 219     /**
 220      * modify template_resource according to resource handlers specifications
 221      *
 222      * @param  \Smarty_Internal_Template|\Smarty $obj               Smarty instance
 223      * @param  string                            $template_resource template_resource to extract resource handler and name of
 224      *
 225      * @return string unique resource name
 226      */
 227     public static function getUniqueTemplateName($obj, $template_resource)
 228     {
 229         $smarty = $obj->_objType == 2 ? $obj->smarty : $obj;
 230         list($name, $type) = self::parseResourceName($template_resource, $smarty->default_resource_type);
 231         // TODO: optimize for Smarty's internal resource types
 232         $resource = Smarty_Resource::load($smarty, $type);
 233         // go relative to a given template?
 234         $_file_is_dotted = $name[0] == '.' && ($name[1] == '.' || $name[1] == '/');
 235         if ($obj->_objType == 2 && $_file_is_dotted &&
 236             ($obj->source->type == 'file' || $obj->parent->source->type == 'extends')
 237         ) {
 238             $name = dirname($obj->source->filepath) . DS . $name;
 239         }
 240         return $resource->buildUniqueResourceName($smarty, $name);
 241     }

  45         if ($_template->source->handler->hasCompiledHandler) {
  46             $_template->source->handler->populateCompiledFilepath($compiled, $_template);
  47         } else {

  49         }

  52             ($_template->smarty->resource_cache_mode & Smarty::RESOURCE_CACHE_ON)
  53         ) {

  59     /**

 160     /**
 161      * Load fresh compiled template by including the PHP file
 162      * HHVM requires a work around because of a PHP incompatibility
 163      *
 164      * @param \Smarty_Internal_Template $_template
 165      */
 166     private function loadCompiledTemplate(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template)
 167     {
 168         if (function_exists('opcache_invalidate')) {
 169             opcache_invalidate($_template->compiled->filepath);
 170         }
 171         $_smarty_tpl = $_template;
 172         if (defined('HHVM_VERSION')) {
 173             $_template->smarty->ext->_hhvm->includeHhvm($_template, $_template->compiled->filepath);
 174         } else {
 175             include($_template->compiled->filepath);
 176         }
 177     }
 178 
 179     /**
 180      * render compiled template code
 181      *
 182      * @param Smarty_Internal_Template $_template
 183      *
 184      * @return string
 185      * @throws Exception
 186      */
 187     public function render(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template)
 188     {
 189         if ($_template->smarty->debugging) {
 190             $_template->smarty->_debug->start_render($_template);
 191         }
 192         if (!$this->processed) {
 193             $this->process($_template);
 194         }
 195         if (isset($_template->cached)) {
 196             $_template->cached->file_dependency =
 197                 array_merge($_template->cached->file_dependency, $this->file_dependency);
 198         }
 199         $this->getRenderedTemplateCode($_template);
 200         if ($_template->caching && $this->has_nocache_code) {
 201             $_template->cached->hashes[$this->nocache_hash] = true;
 202         }
 203         if (isset($_template->parent) && $_template->parent->_objType == 2 && !empty($_template->tpl_function)) {
 204             $_template->parent->tpl_function = array_merge($_template->parent->tpl_function, $_template->tpl_function);
 205         }
 206         if ($_template->smarty->debugging) {
 207             $_template->smarty->_debug->end_render($_template);
 208         }
 209     }
 210 
 211     /**
 212      * compile template from source
 213      *
 214      * @param Smarty_Internal_Template $_template
 215      *
 216      * @return string
 217      * @throws Exception
 218      */
 219     public function compileTemplateSource(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template)
 220     {
 221         $_template->source->compileds = array();
 222         $this->file_dependency = array();
 223         $this->tpl_function = array();
 224         $this->includes = array();
 225         $this->nocache_hash = null;
 226         $this->unifunc = null;
 227         // compile locking
 228         if (!$_template->source->handler->recompiled) {
 229             if ($saved_timestamp = $_template->compiled->getTimeStamp()) {
 230                 touch($_template->compiled->filepath);
 231             }
 232         }
 233         // call compiler
 234         try {
 235             $_template->loadCompiler();
 236             $code = $_template->compiler->compileTemplate($_template);
 237         }
 238         catch (Exception $e) {
 239             // restore old timestamp in case of error
 240             if (!$_template->source->handler->recompiled && $saved_timestamp) {
 241                 touch($_template->compiled->filepath, $saved_timestamp);
 242             }
 243             throw $e;
 244         }
 245         // compiling succeeded
 246         if ($_template->compiler->write_compiled_code) {
 247             // write compiled template
 248             $this->write($_template, $code);
 249             $code = '';
 250         }
 251         // release compiler object to free memory
 252         unset($_template->compiler);
 253         return $code;
 254     }
 255 
 256     /**
 257      * Write compiled code by handler
 258      *
 259      * @param Smarty_Internal_Template $_template template object
 260      * @param string                   $code      compiled code
 261      *
 262      * @return boolean success
 263      */
 264     public function write(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template, $code)
 265     {
 266         if (!$_template->source->handler->recompiled) {
 267             if ($_template->smarty->ext->_writeFile->writeFile($this->filepath, $code, $_template->smarty) === true) {
 268                 $this->timestamp = $this->exists = is_file($this->filepath);
 269                 if ($this->exists) {
 270                     $this->timestamp = filemtime($this->filepath);
 271                     return true;
 272                 }
 273             }
 274             return false;
 275         } else {
 276             $this->content = $code;
 277         }
 278         $this->timestamp = time();
 279         $this->exists = true;
 280         return true;
 281     }
 282 
 283     /**
 284      * Read compiled content from handler
 285      *
 286      * @param Smarty_Internal_Template $_template template object
 287      *
 288      * @return string content
 289      */
 290     public function read(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template)
 291     {
 292         if (!$_template->source->handler->recompiled) {
 293             return file_get_contents($this->filepath);
 294         }
 295         return isset($this->content) ? $this->content : false;
 296     }
 297 }

  96      /**
  97      * get rendered template content by calling compiled or cached template code
  98      *
  99      * @param string $unifunc function with template code
 100      *
 101      * @return string
 102      * @throws \Exception
 103      */
 104     public function getRenderedTemplateCode(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template, $unifunc = null)
 105     {
 106         $unifunc = isset($unifunc) ? $unifunc : $this->unifunc;
 107         $level = ob_get_level();
 108         try {
 109             if (empty($unifunc) || !is_callable($unifunc)) {
 110                 throw new SmartyException("Invalid compiled template for '{$_template->template_resource}'");
 111             }
 112             if (isset($_template->smarty->security_policy)) {
 113                 $_template->smarty->security_policy->startTemplate($_template);
 114             }
 115             //
 116             // render compiled or saved template code
 117             //
 118             if (!isset($_template->_cache['capture_stack'])) {
 119                 $_template->_cache['capture_stack'] = array();
 120             }
 121             $_saved_capture_level = count($_template->_cache['capture_stack']);
 122             $unifunc($_template);
 123             // any unclosed {capture} tags ?
 124             if ($_saved_capture_level != count($_template->_cache['capture_stack'])) {
 125                 $_template->capture_error();
 126             }
 127             if (isset($_template->smarty->security_policy)) {
 128                 $_template->smarty->security_policy->exitTemplate();
 129             }
 130             return null;
 131         }
 132         catch (Exception $e) {
 133             while (ob_get_level() > $level) {
 134                 ob_end_clean();
 135             }
 136              if (isset($_template->smarty->security_policy)) {
 137                 $_template->smarty->security_policy->exitTemplate();
 138             }
 139             throw $e;
 140         }
 141     }

 151             $this->timestamp = @filemtime($this->filepath);
 152         }

 138     /**

 147      * @throws SmartyException

 149     public static function load(Smarty_Internal_Template $_template = null, Smarty $smarty = null,
 150                                 $template_resource = null)
 151     {
 152         if ($_template) {
 153             $smarty = $_template->smarty;
 154             $template_resource = $_template->template_resource;
 155         }
 156         if (empty($template_resource)) {
 157             throw new SmartyException('Missing template name');
 158         }
 159         // parse resource_name, load resource handler, identify unique resource name
 160         if (preg_match('/^([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{2,})[:]([\s\S]*)$/', $template_resource, $match)) {

 165             // or single character before the colon is not a resource type, but part of the filepath
 166             $type = $smarty->default_resource_type;

 168         }
 169 
 170         $handler = isset($smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type]) ?
 171             $smarty->_cache['resource_handlers'][$type] :
 172             Smarty_Resource::load($smarty, $type);
 173         // if resource is not recompiling and resource name is not dotted we can check the source cache
 174         if (($smarty->resource_cache_mode & Smarty::RESOURCE_CACHE_ON) && !$handler->recompiled &&
 175             !(isset($name[1]) && $name[0] == '.' && ($name[1] == '.' || $name[1] == '/'))
 176         ) {

 178             if (isset($smarty->_cache['source_objects'][$unique_resource])) {
 179                 return $smarty->_cache['source_objects'][$unique_resource];
 180             }
 181         } else {
 182             $unique_resource = null;
 183         }
 184         // create new source  object
 185         $source = new Smarty_Template_Source($handler, $smarty, $template_resource, $type, $name);
 186         $handler->populate($source, $_template);
 187         if (!$source->exists && isset($_template->smarty->default_template_handler_func)) {
 188             Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultTemplateHandler::_getDefaultTemplate($source);

 190         // on recompiling resources we are done
 191         if (($smarty->resource_cache_mode & Smarty::RESOURCE_CACHE_ON) && !$handler->recompiled) {
 192             // may by we have already $unique_resource
 193             $is_relative = false;
 194             if (!isset($unique_resource)) {

 203             if (!$is_relative) {
